title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.

As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!

title: E-Commerce Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement

title: Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist
description:
Job Description: Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist

About Us

We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping ecommerce and Shopify brands improve their website visibility, conversion, customer retention, and long-term revenue growth.

We work across areas such as website optimisation,
 marketing, customer journey improvement, SEO, AI search visibility, content strategy, and AI-driven marketing systems.

As search continues to evolve beyond traditional Google rankings, we are building a future-focused SEO service that helps ecommerce brands become more discoverable across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms.

The successful candidate will support both our agency’s own websites and our ecommerce client websites. Brand names and client details will be shared during the interview or onboarding process.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist to join us on a part-time, freelance, or contractor basis, with the potential to transition into a longer-term role based on performance and client demand.

This role is not just traditional SEO.

We are looking for someone who understands Shopify SEO, ecommerce search intent, content strategy, answer engine optimisation, generative engine optimisation, and AI-powered workflow automation.

Your role will be to help our agency and our Shopify/ecommerce clients become more visible across both traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, while also helping us build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for SEO audits, content briefs, optimisation recommendations, reporting, and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Shopify SEO Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute SEO strategies for Shopify ecommerce brands.

• Optimise Shopify collection pages, product pages, homepage content, blogs, and landing pages.

• Conduct keyword research, competitor research, and search intent mapping for ecommerce categories.

• Improve metadata, headings, product descriptions, internal linking, image alt text, and page structure.

• Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.

• Provide practical SEO recommendations that are easy for ecommerce teams to implement.

• Ensure SEO recommendations support both search visibility and customer conversion.

2. AEO — Answer Engine Optimisation

• Structure content so it can answer customer questions clearly and directly.

• Create and optimise FAQ sections for product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and blog content.

• Improve content formatting for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and AI-generated summaries.

• Help ecommerce brands answer high-intent questions such as:

o “Best product for…”

o “How to choose…”

o “What is the difference between…”

o “Is this product suitable for…”

o “How does this compare to…”

• Ensure content is clear, useful, commercially relevant, and easy for both humans and search engines to understand.

3. GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation / AI Search Optimisation

• Optimise websites and content for AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging AI discovery tools.

• Improve content structure for AI retrieval, summarisation, and citation.

• Build topical authority around key ecommerce categories, products, services, and brand entities.

• Recommend ways to improve brand mentions, entity recognition, trust signals, structured content, and content depth.

• Monitor how brands appear in AI-generated responses and identify opportunities to improve visibility.

• Help ecommerce brands become more likely to be discovered, referenced, or cited in AI-powered search experiences.

4. Technical Shopify SEO

• Conduct technical Shopify SEO audits.

• Review indexing, crawlability, sitemap, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, duplicate content, and collection/product page issues.

• Review Shopify theme structure and identify SEO limitations.

• Recommend and implement structured data/schema improvements where appropriate.

• Identify site speed and Core Web Vitals issues that may impact SEO performance.

• Work with developers where required to implement technical improvements.

• Identify Shopify-specific SEO issues such as duplicate URLs, collection/product duplication, pagination issues, tag pages, filter/indexing issues, and thin collection content.

5. Ecommerce Content Strategy

• Create SEO, AEO, and GEO-focused content strategies for Shopify brands.

• Plan blog topics, buying guides, comparison articles, product education content, and collection page content.

• Create content briefs for writers or AI-assisted content workflows.

• Ensure content supports both search visibility and ecommerce conversion.

• Identify content gaps across the customer journey:

o Awareness

o Consideration

o Purchase

o Retention

• Recommend content that helps customers make better buying decisions.

• Create topic clusters that build authority around product categories, customer problems, and ecommerce niches.

6. AI Automation & SEO Workflow Development

A key part of this role will be helping us build AI-powered automation systems for our SEO, AEO, and GEO services.

We are looking for someone who can help design, test, and improve repeatable workflows that make SEO delivery faster, more consistent, and easier to scale across multiple Shopify clients.

This may include helping us build workflows for:

• Shopify SEO audit automation

• AI search / GEO visibility checks

• Keyword clustering and search intent mapping

• SEO content brief generation

• Blog outline and article draft workflows

• Product page optimisation recommendations

• Collection page optimisation recommendations

• FAQ and AEO content generation

• Internal linking suggestions

• Schema and structured data recommendations

• Monthly SEO reporting automation

• Google Search Console insight summaries

• Competitor content gap analysis

• AI-assisted content repurposing for blogs, FAQs,
 newsletters, and LinkedIn posts

The ideal candidate does not need to be a full-stack developer, but should be comfortable working with AI tools, prompts, spreadsheets, SEO tools, and automation platforms.

Experience or interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Claude code, Perplexity, Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, or similar tools will be highly regarded.

The goal is to help us create a repeatable AI-powered Shopify SEO, AEO, and GEO delivery system that can support both agency growth and client service delivery.

7. Agency Website SEO & Growth Support

In addition to client work, you will also support SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI search visibility for our agency’s own websites.

This may include:

• Improving organic visibility for our agency websites.

• Creating SEO and AI search strategies for our service pages.

• Optimising blog content, landing pages, and service pages.

• Identifying keyword and content opportunities.

• Improving internal linking and content structure.

• Creating content briefs for authority-building articles.

• Monitoring how our agency appears in AI search tools and Google results.

• Helping us build inbound lead generation through SEO and AI search visibility.

Reporting & Client Support

• Track SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, or similar tools.

• Prepare simple, practical monthly reports showing traffic, rankings, indexed pages, content opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Summarise Google Search Console insights into clear next steps.

• Explain SEO and AI search recommendations clearly to non-technical clients.

• Help build repeatable SEO/AEO/GEO processes that can be used across multiple Shopify clients.

• Focus reporting on visibility, traffic quality, commercial intent, and revenue opportunities — not just rankings.

Requirements

• Proven SEO experience, preferably with ecommerce or Shopify brands.

• Strong understanding of Shopify SEO, including product pages, collection pages, blogs, navigation, internal linking, and technical limitations.

• Experience with on-page SEO, technical SEO, content SEO, and keyword research.

• Understanding of AEO, structured content, FAQ optimisation, and search intent.

• Strong interest or experience in GEO / AI search optimisation for platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

• Ability to create practical SEO recommendations that support business growth, not just rankings.

• Experience using SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, SurferSEO, or similar.

• Comfortable using AI tools and creating repeatable prompt-based workflows.

• Strong written communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and provide clear deliverables.

• Commercial mindset with an understanding of how SEO supports ecommerce revenue.

Bonus Points

• Experience optimising Shopify collection pages for commercial search intent.

• Experience with schema markup and structured data for ecommerce.

• Experience with AI-assisted content workflows.

• Experience creating SEO content briefs for writers or AI tools.

• Experience with Klaviyo, ecommerce conversion optimisation, landing page optimisation, or
 marketing.

• Understanding of how influencer marketing, UGC, reviews, backlinks, and brand mentions support SEO and AI search visibility.

• Experience building workflow templates, SOPs, or automation systems.

• Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, Google Sheets automation, or API-based workflows.

• Ability to turn SEO processes into scalable service delivery systems.

What You’ll Be Working On

You may work across:

• Shopify SEO audits for ecommerce clients.

• Product page and collection page optimisation.

• SEO/AEO/GEO content systems.

• AI search visibility reports.

• Shopify technical SEO recommendations.

• Monthly SEO support for client brands.

• Blog and content strategies for ecommerce brands.

• Agency website SEO and AI search visibility.

• Internal frameworks and delivery processes for SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI search services.

• AI automation workflows that make SEO delivery faster and easier to scale.

Initial Deliverables

The first phase of this role will focus on helping us build a repeatable Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI automation delivery system.

You may be asked to create:

1. Shopify SEO audit checklist

2. AI search / GEO audit checklist

3. Shopify collection page optimisation template

4. Shopify product page optimisation template

5. Blog content brief template

6. Internal linking checklist

7. Schema and structured data checklist

8. Monthly SEO/AEO/GEO reporting template

9. Google Search Console insight summary workflow

10. Keyword clustering and search intent workflow

11. AI-powered SEO content generation workflow

12. Client-facing SEO/AEO/GEO recommendation template

13. Agency website SEO and AI search growth plan

Role Structure

• Part-time, freelance, or contractor role to start.

• Flexible hours.

• Remote work available.

• Opportunity to grow into a long-term role based on performance and client demand.

• Must be comfortable working across multiple ecommerce brands.

• Ideal for someone who enjoys both SEO strategy and building repeatable AI-assisted systems.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that search is evolving beyond traditional Google rankings.

The right person should be:

• Strong in Shopify SEO

• Curious about AI search and generative search engines

• Comfortable with AI automation and workflow building

• Commercially minded

• Practical and execution-focused

• Able to explain SEO simply

• Focused on traffic, visibility, authority, conversion, and revenue outcomes

• Comfortable building repeatable processes and frameworks

We do not want someone who only focuses on backlinks and generic keyword rankings.

We want someone who can help ecommerce brands become easier to discover, understand, trust, and buy from — across both Google and AI-powered search platforms.

How to Apply

Please include:

• Your Shopify SEO experience

• Examples of ecommerce SEO results you have achieved

• Any experience with AEO, GEO, AI search, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews

• Examples of Shopify product or collection pages you have optimised

• Any experience building AI-assisted SEO workflows, automations, SOPs, or reporting systems

• SEO and AI tools you are experienced with

• Your preferred hourly rate or monthly contractor rate

Company: Steinke & Company (U.S. Accounting & Tax Firm)

Schedule: Must overlap U.S. Central Time business hours — approx. [8:00 PM – 2:00 AM Manila time], Monday–Friday

---



About Us



We're a boutique U.S. accounting and tax firm serving around 400 clients, with deep roots in agriculture, construction, and small business. We run a fully remote team across the U.S. and the Philippines, and we're building a modern, technology-driven firm that uses smart systems and automation to do great work without the chaos.



We're looking for a sharp, self-driven operations leader to be the engine room of the firm.



The Role



This is a high-trust position. You will be the daily operator — the person who makes sure the work gets done on time, the team stays on track, and nothing falls through the cracks. You report directly to the CEO and act as her right hand in running the day-to-day operations.



In plain terms: the CEO sets the direction; you own how it actually gets done. You take control, drive outcomes, manage deadlines, and keep the whole operation moving. You'll also work closely with and support our U.S.-based admin on project management and planning.



If you're someone who likes to take ownership, lead a team, and bring order to a busy firm, this role is for you.



What You'll Do



- Run daily operations — own the workflow, assignments, and due dates so the firm hits every deadline

- Direct and support the team — keep U.S. and Philippine staff organized, accountable, and rowing in the same direction

- Own project management and planning — work alongside our local admin to map out workloads, capacity, and timelines

- Hold the line on deadlines — especially through tax season and the monthly close cycle

- Build and maintain systems — document processes (SOPs), find bottlenecks, and improve how the firm runs

- Report to the CEO — track progress, flag risks early, and keep leadership informed

- Take initiative — see what needs doing and make it happen without being told twice



Must-Haves (Non-Negotiable)



- Accounting / tax firm experience — you understand how a firm works, what deadlines mean, and the rhythm of tax season and monthly close

- Strong project management skills — you can plan, assign, track, and deliver work across a team

- Proven ability to manage deadlines under pressure without dropping the ball

- Hands-on experience with Google Workspace, Canopy, and QuickBooks — these are the tools we run on every day, and you should already know them

title: PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience here. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
## Senior Video Editor — Narrative Film & TV



**Location:** Fully remote · **Type:** Full-time · **Compensation:** $5,000/month USD · **Reports to:** Post-Production Supervisor



### About us



We're a stealth-stage narrative studio building premium episodic and short-film work — think prestige storytelling with a small, senior-heavy team. We're keeping details under wraps for now; more on the slate and the team once we connect.



### The role



We're looking for a senior editor who cuts story, not just footage. You'll take projects from assembly through final picture lock — shaping performance, pacing, and structure in close partnership with directors and writers. This is a craft-led ownership role at the top of our editorial bar: you'll be trusted with entire episodes or films and expected to have a clear point of view about why a cut works.



### What you'll do



- Build assemblies, rough cuts, and fine cuts for narrative projects, making decisive choices about performance, rhythm, and scene structure.

- Partner directly with directors and showrunners through the cut, translating notes into edits and pushing back thoughtfully when the story calls for it.

- Own pacing and tone across a piece — finding the emotional spine of scenes and the throughline of the whole.

- Manage your own media end to end: organize footage, sync dailies, maintain clean project hygiene and version control across a remote pipeline.

- Prep and hand off cuts for sound, color, and VFX, and integrate temp music, sound, and visual placeholders to sell a cut.

- Set editorial standards and mentor junior editors and assistants across projects.



### What we're looking for



- 6+ years editing narrative film and/or scripted television, with a reel that demonstrates story sense — not just technical polish.

- Mastery of at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, Avid Media Composer, or DaVinci Resolve) and the adaptability to work in a studio's chosen toolchain.

- A strong instinct for performance and pacing — you can feel when a scene runs a beat too long.

- A track record of carrying projects through multiple rounds of director's notes without losing the thread of the story.

- Fully self-directed in a remote setting: excellent communication, disciplined file management, and reliable delivery against deadlines without supervision.



### Nice to have



- Experience with remote review workflows (
, Evercast, or similar).

- Working knowledge of sound design, color, or motion graphics — enough to spec the handoff well.

- A specific genre or tonal strength (drama, comedy, thriller) that matches our slate.



### Details



- **Compensation:** $5,000/month USD, full-time

- **Time zone:** Async-friendly, with occasional live review sessions; some overlap with AEST business hours preferred.

- **To apply:** Reply to this listing with your reel and a short note on a cut you're proud of and why.



That's a ready-to-post draft. I can drop it into a Word doc if you want something to send around, or keep tweaking.

title: Digital Marketing Assistant
description:
Who we are:

ColdBru is a next-gen DTC growth team that partners with DTC brands to drastically improve their growth trajectory when other options don't move the bottom line. Our purpose is to help people learn, grow and be the best versions of themselves through the journey of entrepreneurship. We are committed to being the unfair advantage behind our partner brands, and launching a group of our own brands to operate.



We value being fast, data-driven, customer-centric, and adaptable in our approach.

Simply put, ColdBru is the unfair advantage behind its partners' bottom-line growth.



What you'll do (EST time zone overlap required):

Support our growth team in the trenches of performance marketing and AI-powered customer experience optimization.



Execute day-to-day performance tracking and reposting across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok campaigns - you'll be the one catching data discrepancies before they become problems and keeping our reporting bulletproof.



Assist with campaign setup and launches across multiple advertising channels, helping our media buyers move fast without breaking things.



Manage AI customer service tools across multiple client accounts - you'll be optimizing AI systems, reviewing AI responses for brand consistency, and escalating the complex stuff that needs human touch.



Generate performance summaries and insights that actually matter, not just vanity metrics (we're all about that bottom-line impact).



Help maintain marketing calendars, campaign schedules, and project timelines so nothing falls through the cracks.



Support various growth experiments and initiatives - when we need to test something new, you'll be right there helping make it happen.



The Digital Marketing Assistant will work closely with our media buying and growth teams.



We move fast and details matter - if a campaign is off by even 1% in tracking, you catch it. If an AI response doesn't sound like our client's brand, you fix it. You're the safety net that lets our team swing for the fences without worrying about the fundamentals. If you get this, put your go-to productivity hack in ALL CAPS in the first line of your application.



Who you are:

You have some experience in digital marketing, social media, or performance marketing and you're hungry to level up fast.



You're obsessed with getting things right the first time and have an eye for details that others miss. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball and actually enjoy the puzzle of troubleshooting data discrepancies.



You're looking to learn from a world-class team and want hands-on experience with the tools and strategies that drive real growth at scale.



Nice To Have/Bonus Skills:

- Experience with Google Analytics,
 
, or other marketing analytics tools

- Familiarity with AI customer service platforms or chatbot management

- Knowledge of Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or other advertising platforms beyond Meta

- Experience with project management tools (Asana, 
, Notion)

- Basic understanding of marketing automation



Where we're going:

We're a team of handpicked individuals hell-bent on profitable growth for the sake of it, we get up in the morning energized to crack the latest growth problems wide open just cause it sounds fun. We wouldn't settle for anything less and don't take 'No' for an answer. No task is too big or too small, if it's needed to achieve profitable growth we find a way to do it or get it done. We aren't on a hiring spree and will only onboard someone on the same wavelength. That being said, if you think you can outperform and don't have all the experience above, we're open to chatting - ownership and follow-through are what we really care about.



Benefits:

Learn from a world-class team leading the space

In 6 months you'll learn more than other people learn in 3 years

Essentially unlimited self-improvement budget (online courses, and other educational experiences)

Retreats

Flexible working hours

Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world (need to overlap with EST work hours)

Performance incentives

A coffee stipend, if you work at ColdBru you don't pay for coffee. Period.

A wellness budget, we care about your physical and mental well-being, this stipend is there to help you with it, however you see fit.

No meetings Friday, and if you get all your work done by Thursday, take Friday afternoon off!



To apply
 
 & put coffee as your word to be considered

title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description:
About Us



We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.)



This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

title: HighLevel (GHL) Systems Architect & SaaS Implementation Lead
description:
Hi there! I'm glad you're here! 



First, check out the video introduction for this position here: 



Then check out the job description below. It is a little lengthy. Lots to say!



WHO WE ARE

Valeo Digital is a boutique digital agency based in Memphis, TN. For over 20 years, we have worked with an incredible roster of long-term clients, mostly on retainer. However, we are currently in the middle of an exciting structural evolution. For the past year or so, we have been migrating existing retainer clients over to GHL. We are now ready to aggressively scale a SaaS side of our business by developing and launching productized verticals.



That is where you come in! This position is completely dedicated to pioneering, programming, and building out our new SaaS products on GHL. You won't be marooned on an island, though. You will have a world-class team backing you up, including a copywriter for your automated messaging sequences, and a senior full-stack developer to handle custom database configurations, advanced API integrations, and custom JavaScript code.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a true HighLevel Certified Admin who is an absolute system configuration speed demon. You know every switch, custom value parameter, button, conditional workflow action, and backend setting inside the platform like the back of your hand. You build clean, logical, and highly scalable software architectures.



You do not guess; you execute with precision. You do not get lost in documentation trying to figure things out because you already have the deep platform muscle memory from hours inside the GHL trenches. You are comfortable working independently under direct strategic vision, can track clean execution parameters, and can map out clear, step-by-step implementation checklists for our fulfillment coordinators to deploy your snapshots flawlessly.



EXPERIENCE NEEDED

-Must hold a verifiable, active GoHighLevel Certified Admin credential (you will be required to provide your official verification link).

-Deep mastery of Sub-Account Architecture and Snapshots, specifically using Custom Values and Custom Fields to build highly scalable, easily cloneable, variable-driven frameworks.

-Advanced proficiency in Workflows and Conditional Logic (If/Else mapping, internal wait steps, triggers, inbound webhooks, and error-handling loops).

-Expertise in AI Call Agent configuration, including inbound/outbound call routing, custom conversation flow programming, and workflow integration for live-call handoffs.

-Total proficiency in configuring native landing pages, forms, custom calendars, surveys, and review/reputation management pipelines.

-Demonstrated knowledge of navigating text messaging regulatory frameworks (A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration compliance).



DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE (BUT NOT REQUIRED)

-HighLevel Advanced Specialized Badges (A2P Compliance Badge, AI Employee/AI Studio Badge).

-Experience configuring native conversational AI bots and building structured Q&A training tables.

-Familiarity with automation middleware tools like n8n, Make, or Zapier to communicate seamlessly with our custom developer.

-Past experience working with or building workflows for high-ticket industries (Auto or Marine Dealerships, Home Services, or Industrial B2B).



WHY CHOOSE VALEO DIGITAL?

At Valeo, we believe in a balance of hard work and personal development. You will be part of a supportive team that values collaboration and continuous learning. We appreciate each victory, no matter how small, and we learn together from every challenge.



And the pay is good, and we believe in good benefits. If the company does well, I want all of my employees to do well. Bonuses are paid at the end of the year based on the company profit margins.



If you are excited about the future of SaaS development, ready to take your skills to the next level, and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, then we would love to hear from you.



SALARY AND PAY

-The salary range for this position is ?1,020,000 - ?1,500,000 per year (approximately PHP 85,000 – PHP 125,000 per month) for full-time work, 40 hours per week. 

-Salary will be commensurate with experience and technical execution capability.

-We offer the 13th-month bonus to employees who have worked with us for over 6 months.

-This position is eligible for bonuses based on product performance and scale milestones.

-Salary increases are given annually, based on merit.



ADDITIONAL BENEFITS:

We are looking for a great, long-term employee. That means, we want you to be successful! This is not just a job, it is a career opportunity with benefits:

-After the 6-month probation period, we will cover 50% of contributions for SSS, Philhealth, Pag-IBIG Fund.

-Paid Time Off is available immediately, if you need it. No accrual.



WORK SCHEDULE AND HOLIDAYS

-This is a full-time position (40 hours per week).

-Our normal business hours are Monday through Friday, but you choose your hours.

-Your schedule is flexible, as long as your work is being done well and on-time.

-You need to be available on Monday evening for the company tea
eting (10am Central Time U.S.) and it is preferred that you can be reached during our morning business hours for any real-time communication that is needed. Not every day.

-We track our time since we map out project efficiency, so logging your work each week serves as your time sheet.

-We honor regular Filipino holidays, see the next section on Paid Time Off.



PAID TIME OFF

Valeo does not track Holiday, Sick-time and Vacation. We use a Personal Time Off (PTO) policy for all paid days off. You do not accrue days off. You get them at the beginning of each calendar year. Also, note that you will receive the Year 1 allotment on your START DATE, not after the probation period. If you need to take a day or two off in the first few months - that's ok! You have that flexibility. Here are the PTO tiers for Full-time Employees in our employee handbook: 

-Year 1: 11 days

-Years 2-3: 16 days

-Years 4-5: 21 days

-Year 6+: 26 days



INTERVIEW PROCESS

We are going to message back and forth first through OLJ. I want to see how we interact and if it is a good personality fit as well as to learn about your architectural experience.



Then, if we feel like it is a good fit for both of us, you will take an online technical skills assessment. Because your time is valuable and the assessment will take a decent amount of time, I will pay you $50 USD via Wise (or PayPal if you prefer) upon completion. This will be paid regardless of whether you are ultimately selected for the position.



The few finalists who participate in the online assessment will include a Practical Build Sprint inside a sandbox sub-account to demonstrate your platform speed, architectural logic, and system troubleshooting abilities in real-time.



HOW TO APPLY

Send me an OnlineJobs message with a subject line that matches this format exactly:

GHL Expert - {your name} - {today's date}



In the body of the message, you must copy, paste, and answer these questions directly:

1. Please paste the direct link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

2. Provide the live, unique URL to your official GoHighLevel Certified Admin verification page. Screenshots or PDF attachments will not be accepted.

3. What makes you the perfect "configuration speed demon" for this scaling SaaS play?

4. Describe a complex HighLevel Snapshot or Workflow architecture you built from scratch. How did you structure your Custom Values and Custom Fields to ensure it was perfectly scalable and did not break when cloned to a new sub-account?

About the Role:



We're a health and wellness marketing company with several product lines — including men's health/energy & stamina supplements, lymphatic drainage/detox products and . We're looking for someone with a sharp eye for viral short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) who can spot what's working, why it's working, and turn that insight into ideas our team can build creatives around.



This starts as a research and script-writing role, but for the right person it grows into a full Creative Strategist position with real ownership over content direction across our product lines.

Flag which elements of a viral video could realistically be recreated using AI tools (AI avatars, voice cloning, AI b-roll, etc.) as we mainly use AI influencers.

Hand those drafts to our creative team, who will develop them into full ad and organic scripts

Stay on top of platform trends and shifts in what's currently performing





Daily responsibilities:



Find inspiration for 4 current brands, around 8 videos/brand/day.

Transcribing the videos and making sure the words are accurate. 

For shorter videos, rewriting the script with AI for different personalities. 





What We're Looking For



A track record of spotting viral content before it's obvious — you can show us examples of videos you called early or content you helped create that performed well

Strong script or copywriting ability, ideally for short-form video or direct-response ads

A real, practical understanding of AI content tools (AI avatars, voice clones, AI-generated footage) — not just that they exist, but where they fall short and where they shine

Comfort working in the health/wellness/supplement space

Self-directed — you don't need someone telling you which hashtag to check today

Fluent English for writing scripts that land naturally with a US audience





Nice to Have



Experience with DTC/e-commerce brands or performance marketing

Awareness of ad compliance basics for health and supplement claims (we can't make medical claims, and knowing that going in is a big plus)

Past experience trending into a creative strategist, content lead, or UGC manager role

 inbox: triage, draft responses, flag urgent items.

Prepare reports, spreadsheets, and correspondence as needed.

Handle other administrative tasks as assigned.

Minimum 2 years of experience as a virtual assistant or administrative role in a healthcare setting.

Proficiency with healthcare scheduling and/or EHR systems (e.g., Prompt, WebPT, Jane App, Kareo, or similar).

Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Reliable, high-speed internet connection and a private, secure workspace.

Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and maintain confidentiality.



Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with CPT codes for physical therapy services.

Experience with HIPAA-compliant communication tools (e.g., Paubox, RingCentral for Healthcare, Google Workspace with BAA).

Experience with insurance verification.



HIPAA & Compliance Requirements

This position requires access to Protected Health Information (PHI). All candidates must:

Provide proof of current HIPAA training prior to start date (training must be from a recognized provider).

Sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and Independent Contractor Agreement before commencing work.

Agree to use only CE-approved platforms and tools for any work involving patient data.

Consent to periodic compliance audits of workflow and data handling practices.

Report any suspected data breach, unauthorized access, or privacy concern within 48 hours.



Tools & Systems

The following tools are used in this practice (or will be set up prior to start):

Scheduling / EHR: Prompt EMR (data transfer from prior EMR: HelloNote)

Billing: Prompt EMR and Quickbooks invoicing

Communication: Google Workspace with BAA, possibly a phone service TBD

File Storage: Google Drive (BAA), Dropbox

Video Conferencing: Google Meet





Compensation & Terms

Contractor will be paid [hourly/flat rate] via [Easypay / PayPal / Wise / direct wire transfer].

This is a 1099 independent contractor position. No benefits, taxes, or insurance are provided by the practice.

Initial trial period: up to 30 days with evaluation before longer-term engagement.

Either party may terminate the agreement with 14 days written notice.



How to Apply

Please submit the following to 
 with the subject line “VA Application — [Your Name]”:

Current resume or CV highlighting healthcare administrative experience.

Copy of your most recent HIPAA training certificate.

Two professional references from healthcare-related roles, if available.

A short written response (2–3 paragraphs) describing how you would handle the following scenarios:  a. “You a
 send a patient appointment confirmation to the wrong

title: AI Video Ad Creative Assistant / AI Video Ads Producer
description:
We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented assistant to help us create AI-generated video ads for social media platforms like TikTok, Meta, YouTube Shorts, and Reels.



This role is for someone who can help with the full AI video ad creation process, from researching ad ideas and hooks, to creating avatars, writing prompts, generating video clips, organizing files, and preparing final video ad variations for testing.



Our ads are often created for non-English markets, but strong English is the key skill for this role. Most of the creative work, instructions, prompts, research, and communication will be done in English. Scripts can be translated and refined using AI tools, and final script approval will be done by us.



You must be very comfortable working with AI tools and have a strong sense for what makes a good direct-response video ad.



## Main Responsibilities



You will help with tasks such as:



* Researching ad ideas, hooks, formats, and competitor examples

* Coming up with new video ad concepts and angles

* Creating AI avatars / personas for ads

* Creating realistic AI image prompts for characters, settings, and scenes

* Creating AI video prompts for tools like Veo 3.1, HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, CapCut, or similar tools

* Turning scripts into short video scenes or clips

* Creating multiple variations of winning ads, for example new hooks, new avatars, new settings, or new scenarios

* Translating and refining scripts with AI tools when needed

* Organizing all creatives, scripts, prompts, avatars, and versions clearly

* Preparing videos for social media ad testing

* Helping build a repeatable AI video ad production workflow



## What We Are Looking For



You should be:



* Strong in written English

* Very comfortable using AI tools, including tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar

* Creative and able to come up with many ad ideas quickly

* Detail-oriented and organized

* Good at following instructions and improving based on feedback

* Able to understand why some ads perform better than others

* Interested in direct-response marketing, paid ads, UGC ads, and short-form video ads

* Able to work independently after training

* Willing to test, iterate, and improve creative concepts



## Nice to Have



Experience with any of the following is a big plus:



* AI video tools like kie.ai, Veo 3.1, Kling, Runway, Pika, HeyGen, Synthesia, etc.

* AI image tools like Midjourney, ChatGPT image generation, Leonardo, Ideogram, etc.

* AI writing tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar

* CapCut or other video editing tools

* TikTok /
 / Instagram ad creatives

* UGC-style video ads

* Direct-response copywriting

* Experience adapting ads for non-English markets



## Important



This is not just a simple video editing job. We are looking for someone who can become part of our creative production process and eventually take over large parts of the AI ad creation workflow.



You do not need to be an expert on day one, but you must be smart, curious, creative, and willing to learn fast.



## Example Tasks



Here are some examples of tasks you may receive:



* “Create 5 new hook ideas for this video ad.”

* “Generate 3 different avatar concepts for this ad angle.”

* “Turn this script into 8-second video scenes.”

* “Create a video prompt for each scene.”

* “Make this character look more realistic and less polished.”

* “Create a new ad variation using the same script but a different setting.”

* “Organize these winning ads and label the hook, avatar, angle, and format.”

* “Find 10 examples of UGC-style ads and summarize what angles they use.”



## How To Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. Which AI tools have you used before?

2. Have you created AI videos or AI images before? Please share examples if you have them.

3. Have you worked on TikTok,
, Instagram, or YouTube ad creatives before?

4. Are you comfortable using AI writing tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar every day as part of your workflow?

5. Please write 3 short hook ideas for a video ad promoting a mobile fitness app for busy adults.

6. Please create one short AI image prompt for a realistic UGC-style video scene where someone talks about how they use a mobile fitness app in their daily routine.

7. What is your current availability per week?

8. What is your expected monthly salary or hourly rate?



Please start your application with the words: **AI VIDEO CREATIVE**



Applications that do not start with this phrase will not be reviewed.



## Work Setup



* Remote position

* Part-time to full-time possible

* Long-term role if the collaboration works well

* Training and examples will be provided

* You must be able to communicate clearly in English

title: Quality Assistant
description:
Take the test here ? 
 



Shape the Future of Immigration for Global Trailblazers

Join a purpose-driven team reimagining how exceptional talent builds their future in the U.S.



About Lima

Lima is a Silicon Valley-based immigration concierge and career catalyst, dedicated to helping top-tier global talent thrive in the United States. We help founders, researchers, executives, creatives and innovators navigate complex immigration pathways including O-1, EB-1 visas.



The Role

We are seeking a meticulous and proactive Quality Assurance Associate to uphold the highest standards across all client deliverables. You will serve as the final quality checkpoint before documents reach clients, attorneys and partner organizations.

This role requires a sharp eye for detail, strong judgment and a deep understanding of immigration case documentation. You will work closely with Case Managers, Writers, Operations teams and external legal stakeholders to ensure every document is accurate, consistent, well-organized and aligned with case strategy.



Responsibilities

- Document Quality & Review

- Review press articles, recommendation letters, petitions, scholarly publications, memberships and supporting evidence for accuracy, consistency and completeness.

- Verify names, dates, organizations, job titles, timelines and supporting facts across all case materials.

- Identify and resolve inconsistencies, factual mismatches, formatting issues and grammatical errors before client delivery.

- Ensure all written content maintains logical structure, professional quality and alignment with case strategy.

- Act as the final quality checkpoint before deliverables are shared with clients, attorneys or external partners.



Immigration Case Quality Assurance

- Conduct quality reviews of O-1, EB-1 and NIW case documentation.

- Ensure evidence packages meet internal quality standards and support the intended immigration narrative.

- Collaborate with legal teams, attorneys and paralegals to address documentation concerns and maintain compliance with case requirements.

- Flag potential risks, gaps or missing evidence that could impact petition strength.



Document Management & Organization

- Ensure all client folders, evidence repositories, certificates and supporting documents are properly named, categorized and stored.

- Maintain organized and audit-ready client records across Google Drive and internal systems.

- Regularly review active, completed and upcoming cases to identify organizational issues before they become problems.

- Develop and improve quality control checklists, templates and documentation standards.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with the Writing Team to review and approve written materials before they move to the next stage of production.

- Partner with Case Managers to maintain consistency across all client deliverables.

- Provide constructive feedback to writers and operations teams to continuously improve quality standards.

- Support training initiatives and help establish best practices for document review and quality control.



Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify recurring quality issues and recommend process improvements.

- Monitor quality trends across cases and implement preventative measures.

- Help build scalable quality assurance systems as the company grows.



Qualifications

Required:

- Prior experience working on U.S. immigration matters, particularly O-1 and EB-1 visa cases.

- Experience collaborating with attorneys, legal teams and/or paralegals.

- Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify inconsistencies across complex documentation.

- Strong written English proficiency, including grammar, editing and proofreading skills.

- Experience working with Google Workspace 

- Strong organizational and project management abilities.

- Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously while maintaining high quality standards.



Preferred:

- Background in English, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Law or a related field.

- Prior quality assurance, editorial review or legal document review experience.

- Experience reviewing immigration petitions and supporting evidence packages.

- Familiarity with O-1, EB-1 and NIW adjudication criteria.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

- You naturally spot errors others miss.

- You take ownership of quality instead of waiting for issues to be assigned.

- You are highly organized and believe every document should have a clear place and purpose.

- You enjoy creating systems that prevent mistakes before they happen.

- You can balance precision with speed in a fast-moving startup environment.

title: Ramp Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are hiring an experienced AP & Accounting Specialist to own our expense reporting and accounts payable processes. This role sits at the intersection of Ramp platform management and staff-level accounting — consolidating credit card and AP functions, GL coding across multiple entities and dimensions, supporting employees and vendors on payment questions, and maintaining clean financial records.



This is a full-time, dedicated role designed for a detail-oriented professional who brings the rigor of a staff accountant to everything they touch. The majority of this role is payables: processing invoices, managing vendor relationships, coding transactions across multiple lines of business, and keeping Ramp running cleanly — but it goes beyond transactional work.

You'll also support month-end close, prepare accrual entries, reconcile accounts, and coordinate with Legal and Finance on vendor onboarding and compliance. This role is ideal for someone who doesn't just process — you notice patterns, flag discrepancies before they become problems, communicate proactively with vendors and internal stakeholders, and look for smarter ways to work. AI-first workflows are a core part of how this team operates, and comfort with that is a plus.



Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end AP: invoice intake, GL coding, approval routing, and timely vendor payments via Ramp Bill Pay

- Manage and optimize the Ramp platform for both credit card and accounts payable functions including coding, classifying, routing, and mapping configurations

- Code and classify all expenses according to appropriate GL accounts and dimensions across multiple lines of business and classes in Rillet (previous ERP was QBO)

- Review and approve expenses in accordance with company policies and accounting requirements

- Serve as the go-to resource for employees on expense reporting and Ramp platform usage

- Act as the primary point of contact for vendors on payment status, coding questions, and AP matters, proactively following up

- Investigate and resolve vendor payment discrepancies, short pays, and statement reconciliation issues promptly; clear aged items

- Own the full vendor lifecycle: onboarding, record maintenance (W-9s, NDAs, contracts, payment details), periodic Ramp profile reviews, and offboarding

- Ensure all vendor tax documentation is collected, verified, and properly classified (1099-NEC, 1099-MISC, or exempt); lead the annual 1099 filing process in Ramp

- Implement automation for recurring transactions to improve efficiency and accuracy

- Support month-end AP accruals, aging review, and related journal entries

- Continuously learn Ramp updates and improve workflows and vendor profiles

- Assist with month-end close including journal entries, accrued expense rollforwards, and account reconciliations

- Perform balance sheet reconciliations related to Ramp and payables

- Maintain organized supporting documentation for audit and compliance purposes

- File 1099s at year-end in Ramp

- Provide accounting support to the Accounting Manager and Senior Accountant on special projects



Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field preferred; CPA is a plus

- 3+ years of experience in accounts payable, expense management, or accounting roles

- Strong proficiency with the Ramp platform including coding, classifying, routing, and mapping functions

- Strong working knowledge of GAAP, AP processes, GL coding, month-end close, accruals, account reconciliations, and multi-- dimensional accounting structures

- Proficiency in QuickBooks Online, Rillet, or similar accounting software, and AI tools

- Confident communicator comfortable reaching out to vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve issues independently

- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities

- Ability to work US Pacific Time hours



Tools & Systems

Ramp (Bill Pay & Corporate Cards) · Rillet · Google Workspace · Slack · Asana · Claude (AI) · Notion



Schedule

Full-time, 40 hours per week — Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM PST
