title: Meta Ads Account Manager
description:
Meta Ads Account Manager



Full-Time | Remote | SAMA Labs



SAMA Labs is looking for a full-time Meta Ads Account Manager to manage and optimize paid social campaigns for ecommerce and DTC brands.



This role is for someone who understands that great Meta buying is not just about launching campaigns or watching ROAS. We are looking for a performance-minded operator who can connect Meta ads to the full ecommerce growth system: creative, offer, landing page, customer economics, retention, and profitable scale.



The right person can look at an account and understand what is actually happening, what needs to change, and how to communicate that clearly to the team and client.



About the Role



As a Meta Ads Account Manager, you will be responsible for building, managing, optimizing, and reporting on Meta ad accounts across ecommerce brands.



You will work closely with our strategy, creative, retention, Google, and client success teams to ensure campaigns are not just running, but actively improving the brand’s acquisition engine.



This person should be confident inside Ads Manager, but more importantly, they should know how to diagnose performance, identify creative needs, protect budgets, and scale winners responsibly.



Key Responsibilities



Manage and optimize Meta ad campaigns for ecommerce and DTC clients across prospecting, retargeting, and scaling initiatives.



Build campaign structures designed for clean testing, creative learnings, and profitable growth.



Monitor account performance regularly and identify what is working, what is declining, and what needs to change.



Analyze key metrics including CAC, ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR, CPC, CVR, AOV, MER, and blended performance.



Understand client economics, including margin, AOV, LTV, allowable CAC, and payback window.



Translate campaign performance into clear strategic recommendations.



Work with the creative team to identify winning angles, hooks, formats, offers, and iterations.



Help guide creative testing based on performance data, not guesswork.



Identify whether performance issues are coming from creative, offer, landing page, funnel friction, or media execution.



Make informed budget recommendations based on stability, opportunity, and business goals.



Support client reporting with clear, concise insights and next steps.



Communicate proactively with internal teams on account needs, performance shifts, and growth opportunities.



Stay current on Meta platform changes, ecommerce trends, attribution shifts, and best practices.



What We’re Looking For



Strong hands-on experience managing Meta ads for ecommerce or DTC brands.



Ability to manage multiple ad accounts with attention to detail and urgency.



Strong understanding of ecommerce KPIs beyond platform ROAS.



Experience with creative testing, offer testing, campaign scaling, and budget management.



Ability to diagnose funnel performance from ad click to purchase.



Comfortable working with creative teams and giving clear creative direction based on data.



Strong communication skills and ability to explain performance in plain English.



Calm, analytical decision-making during account volatility.



Ability to distinguish short-term performance swings fro
aningful trends.



Organized, accountable, and proactive with daily account management.



Comfortable in a fast-paced agency environment.



The Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate does not just ask, “What is the ROAS?”



They ask:



“What is our allowable CAC?”

“Is this account acquiring new customers profitably?”

“Is creative fatigue setting in?”

“Is the offer strong enough?”

“Is the landing page converting the traffic we are paying for?”

“What creative should we produce next based on what the data is telling us?”



We are looking for someone who thinks like a growth operator, not just a media buyer.



Required Experience



2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads management experience.



Experience managing ecommerce or DTC ad accounts.



Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager, campaign structure, pixel events, attribution, audiences, and creative testing.



Experience managing budgets, scaling campaigns, and troubleshooting performance declines.



Ability to read and interpret ecommerce performance data.



Strong written and verbal communication skills.



Bonus Experience



Experience with Shopify brands.



Experience with Triple Whale, Wicked Reports, Northbeam, GA4, Klaviyo, or similar platforms.



Experience working inside an agency.



Understanding of
/SMS, CRO, landing pages, and retention marketing.



Experience writing creative briefs or performance-based creative feedback.



What Success Looks Like



You are able to keep accounts organized, active, and moving forward.



You identify performance problems before the client does.



You communicate clearly with the internal team about what needs to happen next.



You help turn ad performance into better creative direction.



You understand when to scale and when to protect the budget.



You help clients acquire customers more efficiently and profitably.



Schedule



Full-time role

Monday through Friday

Remote position

Must be available during standard Eastern Time business hours



About SAMA Labs



SAMA Labs is a performance growth agency built by ecommerce operators. We help ecommerce brands scale through paid media, creative strategy, retention, Google Ads, Meta Ads,
/SMS, CRO, and full-funnel growth strategy.



Our team works with brands that need more than basic campaign management. We help clients understand their numbers, improve their funnel, and build systems that support profitable growth.



How to Apply



Please send your resume, a brief summary of your Meta ads experience, and examples of ecommerce brands or campaigns you have managed.

When a Meta account’s CPA suddenly rises, what are the first five things you look at before making changes?

description:
Position: Virtual Executive Assistant (Healthcare / Private Practice)

Reports to: Chief Medical Officer (CMO)

Collaborates With: Practice Coordinator, Medical Biller, and Clinical Providers

Job Type: Part-time (10–15 hours/week to start), long-term position. Time tracking required.

Shift / Availability: Flexible daily hours, but must include a mandatory daily 15-to-30-minute check-in sync with the Colorado team during one of two windows: either 8:00 AM MST or 4:00 PM MST.



ABOUT OUR PRACTICE

We are a thriving, high-quality private psychiatric practice based in Colorado. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional, streamlined, and compassionate mental health care to our community.

We are expanding our administrative team and looking for a highly disciplined, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant from the Philippines to support our daily clinical operations, provider scheduling, and billing workflows. Because we handle protected health information, strict adherence to HIPAA compliance and data security is an absolute, non-negotiable requirement for this role.



This is a dynamic position for someone who loves systems, catches the tiny details that others miss, and takes pride in keeping a medical practice running like clockwork. If you are proactive, highly organized, and passionate about supporting healthcare delivery, we would love to welcome you to our team.



ROLE & DUTIES

As our Virtual Executive Assistant, you will manage the daily administrative engine of the practice, ensuring our providers can focus entirely on patient care. Your core daily responsibilities will take approximately 3 hours per day, structured around four main pillars:



1. Clinical Coordination & Records Management (Daily)

• Intake Compliance: Audit schedules for upcoming days to ensure all newly scheduled patients have completed and submitted their required digital intake forms. Flag missing documentation for the Practice Coordinator.

• Schedule & ROI Audits: Review each provider’s daily schedule in our Electronic Health Record (EHR) system, SimplePractice, to identify if Release of Information (ROI) has been filled out

• PCP Continuity of Care: Confirm Release of Information has been filled out, then securely fax completed progress notes to the patient’s Primary Care Physician (PCP) to ensure seamless continuity of care.



2. Billing & Financial Audits (Daily)

• Previous Day Review: Review all clinical appointments and billing entries from the previous business day for accuracy.

• Discrepancy Flagging: Ensure appropriate billing codes are attached to sessions and coordinate directly with our Medical Biller to resolve errors, skipped entries, or missing invoices.



3. Outreach & Growth Support (Weekly)

• Market Research & Lead Generation: Identify and map out nearby healthcare practices (e.g., primary care clinics, pediatricians, OB-GYNs, family therapists) in our target Colorado regions for potential referral partnerships.

• Database Management: Compile and maintain an organized spreadsheet of these local practices, including key contact names, phone numbers, and office
 addresses.

•
 Marketing: Coordinate, send, and track professional outreach and marketing
s to these nearby practices to introduce our clinical services.

• Metrics Tracking: Monitor
 open rates, replies, and follow-up schedules to ensure no referral lead goes cold.



4. Team Collaboration & Communication

• Daily Sync: Attend as needed check-in with the CMO, Practice Coordinator, or Biller during our designated MST windows to report completion of daily tasks and flag urgent account items.

• Secure Communication: Maintain responsive, professional communication within our secure team channels regarding operational updates.



REQUIREMENTS

• Experience: Previous experience working as a Medical VA or Executive Assistant for a US-based healthcare practice is highly preferred.

• Software Proficiency: Deep familiarity or a strong technical aptitude to quickly master SimplePractice (EHR). Mastery of Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive) is required.

• HIPAA Certification: A solid understanding of HIPAA compliance, patient privacy laws, and secure data handling protocols. (Must be willing to use a secure, encrypted connection/VPN).

• Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

• Attention to Detail: Absolute precision in cross-referencing schedules, medical records, and billing codes.

• Reliability: Consistency in executing daily routine tasks without needing micro-management.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

• Starting Rate: $360 USD / month (calculated based on an agreed 15 hours/week) for the first 6 months.

• Month 7+ Rate: $480 USD / month following a successful 6-month performance review.

• Annual Bonus: 13th-month pay bonus included (pro-rated to your part-time hours).

• Payment: Paid bi-weekly via Wise or direct bank transfer.

• Stability: We treat our virtual team as vital, long-term contributors to our practice's clinical mission, not temporary gig workers.

title: Senior Backend Engineer — Multi-Tenant SaaS + Payments (TypeScript/Node + Postgres)
description:
Be one of two senior engineers who set the quality bar for the software that real truck-repair shops run their entire business on.



We're WrenchEngine — the operational platform a heavy-duty truck & trailer repair shop runs on: work orders, billing, inventory, managed-maintenance, on a multi-tenant / multi-brand foundation with an AI layer on top. Our first customer is an enterprise multi-brand fleet-services company; we're replacing their existing shop software and going live at a pilot shop this fall. Real shops will invoice real money on what you ship.



We build fast with AI (Claude Code is core to how we work), so the bottleneck isn't typing — it's senior review on the two things that can sink us: money-path correctness (invoices, payments, pricing, cores) and multi-tenant data isolation. We have one senior engineer today. You're the second, hired so neither of those rests on one person.



What you'll own:



Final review on tenant/brand isolation — no query ever crosses a tenant boundary, no data leaks between brands. We have a real isolation system (query-layer guard + Postgres row-level security + composite FKs) that's actively being hardened. You own it.

Backup review on the money path (invoicing, pricing, cores) so it's never a single point of failure.

Lead a reversible data migration: moving a customer off their old system into ours, with a tested rollback path and dual-run sync.

Rigorously review AI-generated code — judgment about what's correct and safe matters more than raw output.

Our stack (this is what you'll work in):



TypeScript (strict) monorepo, pnpm + Turbo

Backend: Node + Express, raw SQL over PostgreSQL, layered controller ? service ? repository (~480 endpoints, ~190 SQL migrations)

NATS JetStream for events, Redis cache, Typesense search, S3/MinIO storage

Multi-tenant: brand = organization, group ? brand ? shop, enforced by a scoped-query chokepoint that throws on a missing tenant filter, plus Postgres FORCE row-level security

Auth: FusionAuth (OAuth2), JWT

Frontend: Next.js 15 / React 19 (you don't need to be FE-strong, but it helps)

Integrations: QuickBooks/Intuit, Fullbay, Mitchell 1, GPS telematics, Twilio, SendGrid

~240 backend test files (130+ integration) — tests are the contract here

Must-haves:



Senior backend engineer, strong in TypeScript/Node + PostgreSQL

Real multi-tenant SaaS experience — you've designed or owned tenant data isolation, not just used it

Security fundamentals (authz boundaries, RLS or equivalent, least-privilege)

Payments / financial-integration experience (invoices, pricing, ledgers, or accounting integrations)

A disciplined code reviewer who can explain why a change is safe or not

Comfortable owning data migrations and third-party integrations

Nice-to-have:



Fleet / field-service / automotive or accounting-integration (QuickBooks) domain experience

Experience reviewing/steering AI-generated code

How we work: Small, senior, async team. 2-week sprints with a hard definition of done — tests green, TypeScript strict, tenant-scoped, money-path/security reviewed, merged to main. Remote, Philippines-based.



To apply — read carefully (we filter for this):

Start your reply with the word "WRENCH" so we know you read the post. Then tell us briefly:



A multi-tenant system where you owned data isolation — how did you enforce it?

A money-path or financial bug you caught (or prevented in review).

A data migration or system cutover you led.

Link code or write-ups if you have them. We read for judgment, not buzzwords. Applications that don't follow these instructions won't be reviewed

title: (US) Senior Technical Market Research Analyst / Cold-Call Intelligence Specialist
description:
Instructions to apply in the text. Please follow the to be considered for interview:



We are looking for an exceptionally strong analytical researcher to support a business development and cold-calling team working with manufacturing, industrial, engineering, and technical companies.



This is not a basic VA role. This is a role for someone who can read difficult technical material, understand the business problem behind it, and prepare research that helps our cold-calling team sound highly knowledgeable in the first 30 seconds of a customer conversation.



The goal is simple: when our caller speaks with a potential business customer, the customer should feel: “This person understands our industry, our technical problems, and why this supplier may matter to us.”



Work Schedule



You must be available to work:



Monday evening to Friday evening

11:00 PM to 3:00 AM Philippine time



This schedule is required because the role supports U.S.-time-zone business development. You must be able to maintain focus, energy, and high-quality thinking during this shift.



Main Responsibilities



You will research companies, industries, products, applications, and technical problems before our cold-calling team contacts potential customers.



Your work will include:



Reading technical articles, product descriptions, datasheets, company websites, industry pages, and market information.

Identifying what the target company likely cares about commercially and technically.

Preparing short but powerful cold-call research notes.

Creating smart opening statements and questions that make the customer feel we understand their business.

Finding possible pain points, supplier gaps, product opportunities, quality issues, cost issues, or process risks.

Translating technical information into business-development language.

Supporting lead research for manufacturing, industrial supply, engineering, importing/exporting, and B2B sales campaigns.

Helping the calling team approach each prospect with a customized, intelligent reason for contact.

Required Qualifications



This role is for a serious, highly analytical person.



You must have:



A Master’s degree or equivalent advanced academic background.

Exceptional analytical and logical thinking.

Strong English reading and writing ability.

Ability to read heavy technical material and summarize it clearly.

Ability to connect technical product features to customer pain points.

Strong business curiosity.

Strong discipline and ability to work during the required overnight schedule.

Reliable computer and internet connection.

Ability to work independently without constant supervision.

Ability to produce accurate, useful, and practical research quickly.

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys solving difficult business research problems.



You may be a good fit if you:



Like reading technical or industrial material.

Can understand complex topics even when they are outside your original field.

Can ask, “Why does this matter to the customer?”

Can turn difficult information into simple, powerful sales language.

Are comfortable researching manufacturing, industrial products, engineering applications, supply chains, and U.S. market opportunities.

Think logically and do not just copy/paste from websites.



Read the text below:



“High-vacuum fasteners are not just ‘better stainless screws.’ They are fasteners designed so they do not trap gas, shed particles, outgas oils/water/hydrocarbons, or create ‘virtual leaks’ inside a vacuum chamber.



In vacuum terminology, HV is commonly around 10?³ to 10?? mbar, and UHV around 10?? to 10?¹² mbar. At those pressures, surface cleanliness and tiny trapped gas volumes start to dominate performance, so ordinary fasteners can become a real process problem.



The core problem: virtual leaks.



A normal screw threaded into a blind tapped hole traps a small pocket of air under the screw and along the threads. That pocket may slowly bleed gas into the chamber during pump-down. To the vacuum system, it looks like a small leak, even though there is no hole to atmosphere. This is called a virtual leak.



Regular bolts inside a vacuum chamber can leave small air pockets under their threads, and those pockets can take a very long time to pump down because of low gas conductance. Vented screws use drilled holes to prevent gas pockets and speed pump-down. Vented screws provide a path for trapped air and surface contaminants such as water to be pumped away from blind-tapped holes, improving pump-down and reducing virtual leaks.”



Now answer:



Create one cold-call statement or question that would make a potential customer interested in finding a better fastener supplier for their vacuum application.



Your answer should:



Show that you understood the technical problem.

Connect the problem to the customer’s business or process pain.

Sound natural for a real phone conversation.

Be specific, not generic.

Avoid sounding like a textbook.

Make the customer curious enough to continue the conversation.

How to Apply



Please send:



Your resume.

Header of the application must contain word: HIGH IQ.

Your highest degree completed.

Your answer to the test question above.

One example of a difficult topic you researched and explained clearly.

Confirmation that you can work 11 PM to 3 AM Philippine time, Monday evening to Friday evening.

Your expected monthly salary.



Applications without the test answer will not be considered.



What We Offer

Long-term role for the right person.

Direct exposure to U.S. and international business development.

Work involving manufacturing, industrial markets, technical products, and advanced research.

Opportunity to become a key intelligence partner for a business development team.

Clear expectations and serious work for serious professionals.



We are looking for someone with unusual intelligence, discipline, and curiosity. If you enjoy deep research, technical logic, and turning complex ideas into powerful business conversations, we would like to hear from you.

title: Head of Contact Center Operations - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading. We're doing it with a technology-forward approach, actively developing the AI infrastructure that will make this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

The Head of Contact Center Operations is the senior execution leader of MedPro and MP1's contact center — the person who makes the operation run, improves it continuously, and manages the managers who manage the floor. You report to the VP of Operations and translate their strategic direction into daily operational reality.



This role sits at the intersection of operator and thought partner. You have done this before: run high-volume, multi-channel service environments, built capacity plans between labor and systems, designed operating models from the ground up, and led teams through system migrations without losing service continuity. You are not here to hold the org steady — you are here to elevate it.



Where the VP of Operations sets the vision, you own delivery. When the VP of Operations needs to present performance to the COO, the data, the narrative, and the operational confidence behind it come from you. When the organization needs its service processes redesigned, its CRM environment assessed, or its team structure rebuilt — that work belongs to you.



Key Responsibilities:

Multi-Layer Team Leadership & People Development

• Lead, coach, and develop Operations Managers and Team Leads — you manage the managers, and they manage the floor. Build leaders who build others.

• Establish clear performance expectations, coaching cadences, and accountability frameworks across all leadership levels — weekly 1:1s, call calibrations, structured performance reviews, and real-time feedback loops.

• Drive workforce planning and capacity modeling: design the right staffing structure between labor, channels, and volume patterns — not just fill headcount, but engineer capacity.

• Build succession plans and internal development pathways that reduce external hiring dependency and create a promotion pipeline from within.

• Own recruitment strategy for the operations team in partnership with HR — attract, hire, and retain the caliber of leader and frontline talent that the CSO model demands.

• Foster a performance culture aligned to MedPro's values: Do the Right Thing, Figure It Out, Win as a Team, and Accountability & Ownership.



Operating Model Design & Service Delivery

• Assess the current state of the contact center operation — people, process, structure, channels, and systems — and translate findings into a clear-eyed redesign plan with sequenced priorities.

• Design and implement the operating model: how the team is structured, how work flows through channels, how performance is governed, and how the organization scales as the client base grows.

• Own day-to-day operational performance across all service channels — inbound and outbound voice,
, chat, and SMS — with direct accountability for SLA attainment, handle time, first-contact resolution, and quality scores.

• Build and maintain the full SOP and playbook library: every process documented, auditable, and owned. If it is not written down, it does not exist.

• Own the quality assurance framework — define rubrics, conduct or oversee audits, deliver structured coaching feedback to leads, and use quality data to drive continuous improvement.

• Manage real-time workload distribution across channels — monitor queues, adjust staffing deployment as volume shifts, and act on performance signals without waiting to be asked.



System Assessment & Service Technology Migration

• Conduct a thorough assessment of the current CRM and service technology environment — understanding what exists, what is working, what is limiting, and what migration path forward best serves the operation.

• Lead the end-to-end service system migration: requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, workflow configuration, data mapping, agent training, parallel testing, and go-live — while maintaining service continuity throughout.

• Design and configure case management workflows, escalation paths, SLA tracking, and omni-channel routing logic in the new system, aligned to MedPro's service model and client base.

• Partner with the internal technology team to ensure all system integrations — IVR handoffs, client account data, ticketing — flow cleanly from day one.

• Build post-migration operating model documentation: how cases are created, routed, resolved, escalated, and reported — so no process lives in someone's head.

• Drive full agent and Team Lead adoption: training materials, live coaching sessions, compliance monitoring, and performance metrics in the new system until it is the single active system of record.

• Design, build, and maintain IVR call flows that intelligently route clients, reduce handle time, and improve containment — build these, not just manage ones that already exist.



Performance Management, Data & Reporting

• Own the KPI framework — define the right metrics, build the dashboards, and drive accountability systems that make performance visible and improvable at every level of the team.

• Deliver structured weekly and monthly performance reports to the VP of Operations — covering channel SLA attainment, CSAT trends, quality scores, case volume, and system migration status.

• Translate floor-level data into operational decisions and clear narrative: what is driving variance, what specific action will improve it, and what the risk is if it is not addressed.

• Communicate proactively to the VP of Operations about service risks, capacity issues, and migration blockers — full transparency, solution-first framing, no surprises that should have been visible earlier.

• Identify and scope AI-assist and automation opportunities (IVR containment, agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection) — bring the VP of Operations a prioritized business case, not just ideas.



Client Experience & Regulatory Compliance

• Own the client experience at the operational level — serving as the escalation point for complex service issues and ensuring every client interaction reflects MedPro and MP1's positioning as a true compliance partner.

• Map and continuously improve the client journey across all contact touchpoints — identifying friction, closing gaps, and driving measurable improvements in client satisfaction scores.

• Ensure operational adherence to all applicable data security, privacy, and healthcare regulatory requirements including HIPAA and related standards.

• Partner with Sales and Client Success to align operational delivery with client growth, renewal, and expansion strategies.



Qualifications:

Required

• 10–15 years of total experience in contact center operations, service delivery, or BPO leadership — with significant, demonstrable accountability for team performance, service transformation, and operational change.

• Minimum 5 years in a senior people-management role with direct accountability for multi-layer teams (managers managing managers), department-level KPIs, and operational planning. Candidates who have only managed frontline teams — and not managed managers — will not be a fit.

• Proven experience operating in high-volume, multi-channel service environments with large numbers of customer interactions across voice,
, chat, and digital touchpoints. This is an execution role — we need someone who has run the floor at volume, not just designed programs from above it.

• Demonstrated experience leading a service system migration in a live contact center — transitioning a team from a legacy CRM to a modern platform while maintaining service continuity. Salesforce Service Cloud experience is strongly preferred.

• Hands-on capacity planning expertise: ability to model the right labor structure against channel mix, volume forecasts, and SLA requirements — and build the operating model that delivers it.

• Deep IVR design and multi-channel routing experience — you have built IVR flows from scratch, configured routing logic, and measured containment impact.

• Strong analytical capability — builds and interprets dashboards, identifies performance drivers, and communicates findings clearly to senior leadership.

• Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills for daily interaction with U.S.-based leadership.

• Background in healthcare BPO, compliance services, regulated service industries, or U.S.-facing contact center operations strongly preferred.



Nice-to-Have

• Experience with AI-assist tools in contact center settings: agent-assist prompts, chatbot deflection, predictive routing.

description:
JOB TITLE:

AI Video Ad Creator. Premium Health Brand (Project-Based, Long-Term Potential)



ABOUT US:

We're Gumly, a new premium functional pouch brand launching in Europe.

Our product combines clean energy, focus, and active gum care in a

single nicotine-free pouch. Designed for high-performers, founders,

athletes, and former nicotine pouch users who want a healthier

alternative.



We're building a brand that looks and feels medical-grade and premium.

Think Athletic Greens meets a Swiss pharmacy. We need a skilled AI

video ad creator who can bring this aesthetic to life.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Creating short-form video ads (15 to 60 seconds) for social media,

primarily Meta (Instagram,
) and TikTok. Each ad will combine

two visual layers:



1. Hyper-realistic AI UGC. People explaining the product on camera

in a natural, authentic way. The AI people need to look genuinely

human, not uncanny or "AI-looking."



2. High-end AI-generated medical and scientific visuals that bring our

product story to life. You'll need to use AI tools creatively to

produce premium, clean, science-inspired imagery that visualizes

what our product does. Quality and polish are everything.



The aesthetic we want is high-end and premium. Think Magic Mind, Seed,

Cymbiotika, or Boka. Clean, trustworthy, scientific, but visually

approachable. Not raw medical photography, not casual UGC, not

cartoonish.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Proven experience creating AI video ads for brands.

Deep working knowledge of AI video tools such as Veo 3, Sora, HeyGen,

Runway, Kling, or equivalent. You should be able to tell us which

tool you'd use for what and why.

Strong eye for premium, clean, medical aesthetic. Not cartoonish,

not over-saturated, not "AI-looking."

Skilled in producing realistic AI UGC where the people look genuinely

human.

Editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) for final assembly,

captions, sound design, and color grading.

Comfortable working from a brief. We'll give you the key messaging,

target audience, and reference visuals. You turn it into a finished

ad.

Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.

Minimum 2 hours of overlap with European working hours (CET) for

feedback rounds.



NICE TO HAVE:

Experience in health, wellness, supplement, or pharmaceutical marketing.

Understanding of paid social ad performance and what drives conversions.

Copywriting skills to refine scripts you receive.



HOW IT WORKS:

This role starts as project-based (paid per video ad).

We'll begin with a paid test project to assess fit and quality.

If we see a strong match, this can transition into a permanent role

with a competitive monthly salary and consistent workload.



TO APPLY:

Please do not send your full portfolio. Instead, send us exactly two

examples that prove you can deliver what we need:



1. One AI UGC video. The single example from your work that you

believe best matches the style for a brand like Gumly. We want to

see an AI person that looks genuinely realistic and a production

level that fits a premium health brand. Pick the one example that

shows your best work in this style.



2. One example of 3D, motion graphics, or animation work where the

medical visuals (or similar premium scientific visuals) are

clearly visible. If you haven't made medical visuals before, send

one example that proves you have the underlying skill to create

them. Product visuals, abstract animations, or any work that

demonstrates the level of polish we're after.



In addition, briefly answer (a few sentences is fine):

Which AI tools do you use most and why?

Your rate per finished video ad (15 to 30 second format) and your

typical turnaround time.

Confirmation that you can work with at least 2 hours of overlap

with European time.



Applications without these two specific examples will not be considered.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Integration & Automation Developer
description:
Position Overview

Are you the kind of developer who gets excited building systems that actually work — not just writing tickets in a corporate queue? We are hiring our very first internal Integration & Automation Developer, and this is a rare opportunity to own the entire technical foundation of a growing company from day one.



You will not be one of dozens of developers. You will be THE developer. If you thrive on real ownership, shipping things that matter, and seeing the direct impact of your work on a business you care about — keep reading.



What You Will Own



You will be the core technical anchor of our internal operations: architecting and maintaining our database, building automated workflows in the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate and Power BI), and connecting our internal tools through seamless REST API integrations.



Key Responsibilities



Power Automate - Workflow & System Automation: Design, build, and scale automated Cloud and Desktop flows to connect internal applications, sync business data, trigger smart notifications, and eliminate manual work across the organization.



Power BI - Reporting & Dashboards: Build and maintain powerful, clear dashboards and reports that transform raw business data into real insights for decision-makers. You will own the data story.



API & System Integrations: Build reliable, well-structured connections between our internal systems and third-party cloud tools using REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON — making sure data flows exactly where it needs to go.



Internal App Development: Design and deploy custom internal tools, forms, and data-driven apps using Microsoft Power Apps — built to actually solve the problems our team faces every day.



What We Are Looking For



Microsoft Power Automate: Deep, hands-on experience building complex, reliable Cloud and Desktop flows. You know how to architect flows that don't break, scale well, and connect systems cleanly.



Microsoft Power BI: Proven ability to build dashboards and reports connected to live data sources. You can model data effectively and present it in a way that non-technical stakeholders actually understand.



API & Integration Skills: Strong working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON data structures, and authentication standards like OAuth and API keys.



Database Experience: Comfortable working with relational databases — querying, maintaining, and building integrations on top of structured data.



Why This Role Is Different



True Ownership: You are not a small cog in a massive machine. You will own the technical landscape, set the direction, and see the direct impact of your work every single day.



100% Remote Work: Work from the comfort of your home with a stable, predictable schedule. Working hours are 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST.



Long-Term Career Growth: As our first internal technical hire, you are not just taking a job — you are building a career with a company that is investing in you for the long haul.



No Bureaucracy: We move fast, communicate directly, and cut through the red tape. Your ideas will be heard and your work will matter.



A Quick Note on How We Work

This role is built on trust, direct collaboration, and long-term partnership. A few things to know before you apply:



Direct Relationships Only: We hire individuals directly. We are not looking to work with agencies, outsourcing firms, or representatives acting on behalf of other developers.



Our Commitment to Focus: This is a full-time, dedicated internal role requiring 100% focus during working hours.



Interactive Technical Screening: We want to see how you think in real-time. Our technical evaluation is a casual, collaborative live video call where you will keep your camera on and walk us through a Power Automate and Power BI scenario.



How to Apply (Required Screening Questions)

To be considered, please answer ALL of the following questions in your cover letter.



Please confirm that you are looking for a single, dedicated full-time role and do not currently hold overlapping corporate full-time contracts.



Are you completely comfortable with a live, camera-on, screen-share technical evaluation where you will walk through a Power Automate and Power BI scenario in real-time?



Describe a Power Automate flow or Power BI report you built that had a direct, measurable impact on a business process. Be specific — what was the problem, what did you build, and what changed?



Please record and submit a short video (2–3 minutes) introducing yourself. Tell us who you are, what draws you to this specific role, and briefly walk us through one integration or automation project you are proud of. Upload it to YouTube (unlisted), Google Drive, or Loom and paste the link here. This helps us get a sense of how you communicate — an important part of this collaborative role.

title: Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research Specialist – UK Marketplace

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Research Specialist to support our growing Amazon UK business. The main focus of this role is to identify profitable, low-risk products for resale on Amazon UK using trusted product research methods and Amazon seller tools.



The ideal candidate must understand the UK Amazon marketplace, online arbitrage sourcing, product analysis, sales rank, profit margins, ROI, competition, pricing trends, and Amazon fees. Key Responsibilities

Research profitable products for Amazon UK Online Arbitrage.

Source products from UK retail websites, clearance sections, discount stores, and online suppliers.

Check product profitability, ROI, sales rank, estimated monthly sales, competition, and price history.

Review Keepa charts to understand price trends, Amazon stock activity, and sales history.

Check whether products are gated, restricted, hazmat, IP-risky, or unsuitable for resale.

Calculate Amazon FBA/FBM fees, VAT considerations, shipping costs, and expected net profit.

Create and maintain product research spreadsheets with key details such as product name, source link, Amazon ASIN, cost price, sale price, profit, ROI, sales rank, and notes.

Monitor competitors, Buy Box trends, and stock availability.

Help build a reliable product sourcing pipeline for the UK marketplace.

Support other Amazon selling tasks related to product research, listing checks, and supplier sourcing where needed.

Our mission is to help people achieve healthier skin through innovative products, exceptional education, and world-class customer experiences. We're looking for empathetic, curious, and detail-oriented Customer Experience Associates to join our growing team. This role goes beyond traditional customer support. , social media, and other support channels to ensure every customer interaction reflects our commitment to care, empathy, and excellence.

- 2+ years of customer support, customer experience, or customer success experience

- Strong empathy and active listening skills

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

We believe technology should enhance human connection—not replace it.

title: Care Coordinator Auditor
description:
The Care Coordinator Auditor is responsible for conducting monthly audits of the performance of Care Coordinators. Using established audit criteria, scoring standards, and quality assurance guidelines, the chart auditor will look for compliance with company policies, documentation standards, communication expectations, and established workflow 
diting patient charts includes searching through Omni Therapy’s EMR platform and communication records. Audit findings are documented and shared with Account Managers to support performance monitoring and consistency across the department. This position is focused exclusively on auditing and reporting and does not include direct employee management, coaching, or disciplinary responsibilities.





Essential Duties & Responsibilities



Monthly Audits

Conduct monthly audits of Care Coordinators’ patient charts using established audit criteria, scoring standards, and quality assurance guidelines.

Review patient charts, documentation, communication logs, scheduling activity, missed visit management, discharge coordination, re-evaluation management, authorization tracking, and other assigned workflow functions.

Evaluate compliance with company policies, home health agency requirements, documentation standards, communication expectations, and established workflow procedures.

Verify completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of documentation and required follow-up activities.

Identify deficiencies, compliance concerns, documentation gaps, workflow issues, and areas requiring follow-up.

Ensure audits are completed accurately, objectively, and within established deadlines.





Audit Documentation & Reporting

Apply audit standards consistently and objectively across all Care Coordinators.

Calculate, document, and maintain audit scores and supporting records.

Maintain complete and accurate audit documentation in accordance with departmental requirements.

Prepare audit summaries, score reports, and findings for Account Managers.

Clearly document audit observations, deficiencies, compliance concerns, and areas requiring corrective action or follow-up.

Track audit results and maintain historical audit data for performance monitoring and reporting purposes.





Trend Analysis & Quality Improvement

Identify recurring documentation issues, workflow deficiencies, and compliance trends across audited charts.

Monitor patterns that may indicate training needs, process gaps, or operational risks.

Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support quality improvement initiatives.

Assist in maintaining consistency and standardization of Care Coordinator processes across all assigned accounts.

Escalate significant compliance concerns or recurring issues to Account Managers for review and action.





Experience: 

2+ years of experience in home health, care coordination, healthcare operations, medical records review, auditing, or a related healthcare support role.

Strong understanding of care coordinator workflows, documentation requirements, scheduling processes, and home health operations preferred.

Previous auditing, chart review, or quality monitoring experience is a plus.



Technical Skills:

Proficient with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems (experience with Devero or similar platforms is a major plus) and communication software like RingCentral (RC).

Proficient with Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets for audit tracking, reporting, and score calculations.

Attention to Detail: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify missing documentation, workflow gaps, compliance concerns, and inconsistencies across patient charts and communication records.

Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to review documentation, identify trends, apply audit criteria consistently, and accurately score performance based on established standards.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document audit findings, summarize observations, and communicate audit-related information professionally and objectively.



Benefits:

Competitive Pay

Annual Bonus

Annual salary increases (Performance Based)

Health Insurance

Paid Holidays

Paid Vacation

Paid Sick Leave





* Must be available to work Monday - Friday, from 9am - 5:30pm Pacific Standard Time.

* Previous experience working night shift with an international company is preferred.

title: LinkedIn Content & AI Tools VA for Career Coach and Keynote Speaker
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

A U.S.-based career coach and keynote speaker is looking for a Virtual Assistant who lives in the details of social media and knows how to take half-finished content and make it land.

This is not a general VA role. The primary job is LinkedIn content management: scheduling posts, closing the last 30% of drafts, keeping a consistent publishing cadence, and making everything look polished before it goes live. Everything else — resume reformatting, Asana management, B2B outreach support — layers on top of that core skill.

If you have never actually managed social media for a coach, consultant, or personal brand, this role is not a good fit. If you have, keep reading.

Pave Talent is hiring on behalf of our client, a one-person career coaching and speaking practice based in the U.S. with a growing pipeline of corporate and B2B clients.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Content and LinkedIn Management (primary, ~50% of your time)



Manage the LinkedIn content calendar and keep posting consistent week over week

Take 70%-complete drafts and get them publish-ready: close gaps, fix formatting, ensure visual quality

Schedule and publish content on LinkedIn and other platforms

Monitor engagement and flag anything that needs attention



Resume and Career Documents



Reformat resumes in Microsoft Word using custom AI prompts (Claude preferred)

Convert resumes into LinkedIn summaries, cover letters, and other career documents

Refine AI-generated output so it sounds human, not generated



Speaking and Event Operations



Process post-event survey responses and send segmented outreach by response type

Conduct LinkedIn outreach to event attendees using provided templates

Track pre- and post-event logistics in Asana



Business Development Support



Support B2B outreach to wealth management firms and companies going through layoffs

Help maintain outreach sequences and track pipeline activity



Operations and Reporting



Manage Asana daily: update task statuses, flag what needs attention, keep dashboards current

Send daily and weekly activity reports





WHO THIS IS FOR

You have managed LinkedIn or social media for a coach, consultant, speaker, or personal brand before. Not just scheduled posts but owned the cadence, caught the gaps, and kept things moving without being chased.

You know how to use AI tools (Claude specifically) and you know the difference between raw generated output and something that is actually ready to publish. You fix the output. You do not just paste it.

You finish things. When something is stuck, you say so before it becomes a problem.

You have reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup. Connectivity issues are a dealbreaker for this role.



REQUIRED



Demonstrated experience managing LinkedIn or social media for a coach, consultant, or personal brand

Proficiency with Claude or similar AI tools, with the judgment to refine output

Asana or equivalent project management experience

Professional written English

Microsoft Word and Google Suite proficiency

Reliable high-speed internet and dedicated home office



BONUS



Background in career coaching, staffing, or HR

B2B outreach or lead generation experience

Experience with content scheduling tools





COMPENSATION AND SCHEDULE



Rate: $8 to $10 USD per hour

Hours: 20 hours per week to start, path to 40 hours based on performance

Schedule: Flexible async with 2 to 3 hours daily overlap at 2:00 PM Pacific (5:00 AM Philippine Time)

Contract, remote, Philippines-based

Start: ASAP





TO APPLY

In your application, tell us about a specific social media account you managed for a coach, consultant, or personal brand. What did you do, how often did you post, and what did you learn about keeping content consistent?

Applications without a direct answer to this question will not be reviewed.

title: Marketing Manager — Organic Growth & Personal Brand
description:
**ABOUT THE OPERATION**



You'd be running marketing for an established real estate personal brand in Coastal Delaware (Rehoboth Beach, Lewes, Bethany, Dewey) that we are building into a national media brand — using a live, working real estate business as proof of concept. The long-term play is a content engine strong enough that other agents pay to learn the system.



This is a ground-floor build, not a tune-up. We have strong existing organic reach, but the branded media operation is early by design:

-A large, engaged personal
 following that we're now converting into a dedicated business brand and page.

-A YouTube channel in its early days, with our first long-form videos
 [channel link]

-An Instagram presence we're rebuilding from the ground up.



We're looking for a builder who can create traction from near-zero — not someone who only optimizes an established machine. One of your first strategic priorities will be making sure the business doesn't depend on any single social platform to generate leads — so if an account gets suspended tomorrow, our lead flow keeps running.



Take a look at what's live and form a real opinion. That's part of the application.



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS - AND ISN'T**



This is not a content creator, social media manager, or editor role. The execution layer is already in place:

-A full-time video editor handling long-form and short-form cutting

-Lead managers running outreach and lead handling

-A titles/thumbnails specialist to be added as the channel scales



You will plan, direct, and improve the marketing machine — content,
, community growth, lead generation, and funnels. You own the strategy and the system: making sure the right content, messaging, people, and processes are in place so the operation produces leads and authority consistently, without constant supervision.



You'll also be responsible for making sure the lead-generation protocols we've put in place are followed by the lead-manager team — both for compliance with each platform's rules and for the long-term health of our accounts.



If you need detailed instructions for every task, want to only write captions, or avoid owning outcomes — this isn't your role.



**PLATFORMS AND CONTENT STRATEGY**



You'll develop strategy across both short-form and long-form:

-Short-form:
 Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and Instagram Reels (as we rebuild IG) — building toward 21+ pieces per week.

-Long-form: anchored on YouTube, with native 
 to
 and 
 where it fits the audience.



You must understand that the same core idea gets cut, reframed, and packaged differently for each platform's behavior — not cross-posted identically. You should know how audiences behave and convert on each, spot trends before they saturate, and turn them into content opportunities. You should also know how to grow sustainably and within each platform's rules — no shortcuts that put accounts at risk.



**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**



1. Strategy — Own and continuously improve the overall marketing strategy. Research competitors and market trends. Launch and test new initiatives. Keep marketing aligned to business objectives.

2. Content Direction & Copywriting — Write or oversee copy across short-form scripts, long-form scripts, social posts,
, lead magnets, and landing pages. Maintain brand voice and quality. Use AI effectively while keeping output authentic and human — and recognize and fix content that reads as AI-generated.

3. Team Leadership — Direct and coordinate the editor, lead managers, contractors, and VAs. Delegate clearly, hold accountability, and improve workflows and communication between them. Make sure the lead-generation protocols are being followed by the lead-manager team.

4. Lead Generation & Funnels — Build and improve organic lead-gen systems and conversion pathways. Develop lead magnets, nurture sequences, and funnels. Track lead sources and campaign performance. Set up for future paid acquisition as the business grows.

5. Past Clients & Referral Network — the foundation of the business. More than 60% of our business comes from past clients and referrals. New audience growth on social is the long game; this is the engine running today, and it cannot get neglected while we chase new reach.

*Past and existing clients: Build and run a consistent, personal-feeling communication program —
, milestone touches, client appreciation — that keeps us top-of-mind so we're the only call when they, their family, or their friends are ready to move.

*Regional Sotheby's agents: Build a deliberate outreach program to the Sotheby's agents in markets that send buyers and sellers to Coastal Delaware. The goal is to be the agent they call when their clients move here, and the relationships should be reciprocal. Our long-form content is a major asset for this — use it.

6. Operations — Build and document SOPs, solve bottlenecks, and keep projects moving without hand-holding. The systems you build are core IP for this business.

7. Analytics & Reporting — Monitor KPIs, produce weekly and monthly reports, and drive decisions from data.



**WHO YOU ARE**



-Deep understanding of organic social growth, virality, and audience psychology

-A builder — comfortable creating traction from near-zero, not just optimizing an existing presence

-Strong copywriter with strong content instincts

-Understands personal branding and both short- and long-form content

-Knows how to grow accounts sustainably and within each platform's rules

-Comfortable leading a team and balancing strategy with execution

-Strong problem-solver who makes decisions and owns the outcome

-Preferred: real estate marketing, personal brand growth, content-team management, organic inbound lead gen, YouTube growth,
/funnels.



**First 90 Days — What Success Looks Like**



-Build a lead system we actually own. Every lead that comes in from social media should be captured onto our
 list, with a follow-up sequence in place to nurture them. The business should not depend on any single social platform to generate leads — if an account gets suspended tomorrow, our lead flow keeps running.

-Past-client communication plan running. A consistent program in place so past and existing clients hear from us regularly in a way that feels personal — not mass-marketing.

-Sotheby's agent outreach plan running. A target list and active outreach cadence to the regional Sotheby's agents we want to be doing referral business with.

-Content shipping on schedule and consistently across active platforms.

-Tea
mbers accountable and workflows documented — including clear protocols the lead-manager team actually follows day-to-day.

-Lead generation steady and measurable — targeting [X] qualified leads/month.

-Audience and YouTube watch time growing off a defined baseline — targeting [Y]% growth.

-Leadership has clear visibility into performance and priorities.



***HOW TO APPLY*** (Please read the instructions carefully)



Keep this tight — we're evaluating judgment, not volume. We're early in building this, so we don't want an audit of a finished machine. We want to see how you think:

1. ONE CASE STUDY — A personal brand, business, or campaign you helped grow. Include objective, strategy, execution, and results (with numbers where you have them).

2. YOUR FIRST MOVE — After looking at what's live, give us a half-page on the single biggest opportunity you see for this brand and the first thing you'd do about it. Be specific and direct.

That's it for round one. Finalists will be invited to a short paid project: a focused 90-day plan for this business. We pay for that work because we respect your time — and because it's the best way for both of us to see how you actually think and operate.



This role is for someone who wants to own a marketing function, not simply participate in one.



Please attach your resume/cv along with the case study and your first move. Don't apply if without marketing experience.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Shark
description:
JOB TITLE: HIGH-TICKET CLOSER / REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS SHARK



Enterprises Elite ( IG 470K+ 
/enterpriseselite/ ) is a real estate investment company that is rapidly scaling our virtual wholesaling operation. Our marketing machine is generating more leads than our current team can handle. We do not need help finding leads; we need a killer to close them.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

We are looking for an experienced, relentless remote Acquisitions Manager. You will be taking warm leads, running property comps, negotiating directly with American homeowners, and locking up real estate contracts.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a customer service or basic virtual assistant role. This is not for order-takers or appointment setters. If you are overly polite, afraid of conflict, or fold the second a seller gets aggressive, do not apply. We need a shark. We need someone who is perfectly comfortable telling a homeowner their house needs $40,000 in work, making a low offer, and confidently sitting in the awkward silence.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Call warm, inbound leads and follow up with our CRM pipeline. Quickly analyze properties using online tools to determine the After Repair Value (ARV) and Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO). Build deep rapport with distressed sellers, uncover their actual pain points, and overcome brutal price objections. Negotiate heavy discounts and secure digital contracts.



REQUIREMENTS TO WIN

PERFECT ENGLISH: Your spoken English must be flawless, with high confidence and strong tonality.

EXPERIENCE: You must have a proven track record of closing high-ticket B2B/B2C sales, preferably in U.S. real estate wholesaling.

TECH FLUENT: You must know how to navigate CRMs and run comps.



THE COMPENSATION

We offer a highly competitive base hourly rate to give you stability, plus an aggressive, uncapped commission bonus for every single contract you lock up that closes. If you are a true closer, you will make significantly more here than standard VA roles.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

If you just click apply and send a generic resume, it will be instantly deleted. To prove you have attention to detail and strong communication skills, you must follow these exact steps:



STEP 1: Make the subject line of your message exactly ELITE CLOSER - [Your Name]

STEP 2: Do not send a cover letter. Instead, record a short 60 to 90-second video of yourself on your phone or webcam.

STEP 3: In the video, introduce yourself, tell us about your highest-ticket sales experience, and explain exactly why you would be a killer fit for this acquisitions role.

STEP 4: Upload the video to Google Drive, Dropbox, or YouTube (make sure the privacy is set so anyone with the link can view it) and paste the link in your application.



If you cannot sell yourself on a short video, you cannot close our leads. We look forward to seeing your pitch.

title: Front End Engineer (AI First Product) (CS Graduate)
description:
Flexible working hours - I'm a US based Product Design Engineer who has built an enterprise level, AI Native, HR Technology product. It's almost ready to launch and I'm looking for its first employee to do many things. I built the whole product using Claude Code. It's 260,000 lines of code with many integrations and APIs. 



You will be someone, maybe even a fresh Computer Science grad with little experience, who is obsessed with AI and want's to get your hands dirty on a big project. There will be lots to do. In the beginning there will be a lot of testing of features - that's really a tester's job, but its one example of where one person can do many things. You'll be debugging big issues, innovating on new products, conducting market research. The aim is for you to become obsessed with the product and utilizing AI to become more efficient. I've been doing many things to date and some bug fixes just take a while and now we're moving to launch, I need to focus my efforts elsewhere. 



I don't need someone who is a very technical engineer - you know too much - I need people who will rely on AI to help figure it out and do things much more quickly. 



This will suit someone who is very proactive, very smart, and can deal with many moving parts at once. You will be given a lot of responsibility and there are a lot of things you can break, so you need to be hyper switched on love chaos and working hard. If that's not you, I totally get it.

title: Part time PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

title: Senior Lending Analys
description:
OVERVIEW:



We are looking for an experienced Senior Lending Analyst to join their team in a fully remote capacity. In this role, you will be the analytical engine of the firm, navigating complex lender policies and leveraging a modern tech stack to ensure every application is structured for success and rapid approval.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

Residential Scenario Analysis: Conduct precise servicing calculations using Quickli and lender-specific tools to determine accurate borrowing capacity for residential clients across a panel of 20+ lenders.

Credit Strategy & Documentation: Prepare high-quality preliminary assessments and Credit Proposal Disclosure (CPD) documents that align with client goals and Best Interest Duty (BID) standards.

Data Integrity & Submissions: Manage the end-to-end data flow within ApplyOnline and Loanapp, ensuring 100?curacy between the client's fact-find and the lender’s portal.

Workflow & Pipeline Management: Utilize Nexus CRM to track application milestones and manage documentation checklists, proactively minimizing lender "More Info" requests.

Compliance Oversight: Execute internal audits on all files to ensure they meet the firm’s high standards for quality and regulatory compliance.



QUALIFICATIONS:

2+ years of experience in credit analysis or senior loan processing strictly within the Australian residential mortgage industry.

Demonstrated proficiency in ApplyOnline (NextGen), Mercury, LoanApp (Simpology), and Quickli.

Direct experience using Nexus or a comparable industry-standard CRM.

Deep understanding of residential lending products, including construction loans, refinancing, and first-home buyer schemes.



PREFERRED SKILLS (nice to have):

The ability to look at a complex scenario and identify the most viable lender path before the broker even asks.

Strong internal reporting skills to keep the brokerage team informed of file progress and potential credit risks.



Benefits:

Opportunities for promotion

Paid training

Work Location: Remote
