title: Mortgage Support (Associate/Specialist/Sr. Associate) from (CA/US/UK/PH/AU etc) – Australian Market
description:
Location: Fully Remote - Work From Home

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience and role placement



About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Direct, proven experience supporting brokers or lenders within the Australian commercial real estate or development finance market.

- Deep proficiency in reading and validating corporate financials (ABN, BAS, NOA) and understanding commercial project metrics (feasibility models, construction drawdowns).

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

- Exceptional analytical capacity and sharp attention to detail.



[CAREER 3] MORTGAGE SUPPORT – SR. ASSOCIATE (Residential Expertise & Team Leadership)



Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior tea
mbers to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.



Key Responsibilities:

- Advanced Pre-Qualification: Conduct initial high-net-worth client consultations to map out homeownership strategies; evaluate complex serviceability and creditworthiness using tools like Quickli and applying the 5 Cs of Lending.

- Complex Loan Structuring: Educate clients on advanced loan combinations and recommend optimal solutions tailored to multi-property portfolios, expertly balancing fixed vs. variable splits and flexible repayment terms.

- CRM & Pipeline Management: Guide clients smoothly through applications while managing files end-to-end utilizing advanced mortgage CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Creatio, and Salestrekker.

- Secure Document Workflows: Oversee the secure and rapid execution of digital documentation utilizing platforms such as DocuSign and Ezidox, ensuring zero data-integrity errors.

- Credit Analysis & Compliance Auditing: Deeply analyze credit bureau reports, formulate credit improvement roadmaps for clients, and ensure absolute adherence to Australian mortgage regulations, including Loan Estimates and Closing Disclosures.

- Post-Closing & Settlement Excellence: Coordinate final document compilation to guarantee frictionless loan settlements; support clients post-settlement with direct debit structures, offset account setups, and ongoing client care.

- Business Development & Networking: Proactively build and nurture long-term relationships with core referral networks (real estate agencies, accounting firms, wealth managers) leveraging LinkedIn, industry forums, and freelancer platforms.

- Tea
ntorship & System Optimization: Act as an escalation point and mentor for junior support staff; spearhead internal process improvements to accelerate client onboarding and minimize application turnaround times.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Significant, hands-on experience in the Australian residential mortgage industry managing end-to-end file flows.

- Mastery of Australian mortgage software and CRMs (specifically Salestrekker, Quickli, Salesforce, or Creatio).

- Experience mentoring tea
mbers, reviewing loan files for quality assurance, or leading process improvements.

- Masterful communication, negotiation, and problem-resolution abilities.



Common Requirements Across All Paths:

- Fluency in professional written and spoken English, with exceptional communication skills suitable for interacting with Australian brokers, lenders, and clients.

- High organizational capability with a demonstrated ability to multitask under tight financing deadlines.

- Adaptability to work hours aligned with Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT).

- High-speed internet access and a dedicated, professional workspace (for remote positions).



--

What We Offer:

- Market-leading salary packages built around your specific role placement.

- Leave Credits with Carryover & Cash Conversion

- YVP Engagement Activities

- Performance-based bonuses and milestone rewards (depending on client)

- Complete training and onboarding on premium mortgage platforms.

- Clear internal pathways for promotion and professional development.

- Collaborative, energetic, and highly supportive team culture.

title: Senior PPC Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a battle-tested Senior PPC Manager to take complete strategic ownership of our Google Ads MCC. This is a highly autonomous role. You will not be micromanaged, but you will be held accountable to hard performance data.



We need a true media buyer who can build complex, high-budget architectures from scratch, audit underperforming accounts, fix broken tracking structures via Google Tag Manager, and confidently communicate performance directly to our clients and leadership team.



If your instinct is to simply turn on Google’s "Auto-Apply Recommendations" and let the algorithm do the work, this is not the role for you. We are looking for an analytical thinker who questions default settings and aggressively protects our clients' budgets.



What You Will Be Doing

Taking Complete Ownership: Auditing, architecting, and managing Google Ads campaigns (Search, PMax, Retargeting, Display) entirely from scratch.



Technical Troubleshooting: Setting up, testing, and fixing complex conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).



Budget Scaling: Safely scaling client budgets without blowing up their Cost-Per-Acquisition (CPA).



Strategic Auditing: Diagnosing stalling campaigns and identifying whether the bottleneck is the ad, the landing page, or the market.



Client Communication: Proactively communicating performance, wins, and strategic pivots to the internal team and directly to clients.



What You Won't Be Doing

Blindly applying Google Support Reps' "Auto-Recommendations" to artificially inflate optimization scores.



Following rigid call-center scripts or support SOPs.



Acting as a middleman between the client and an overseas fulfillment team—you are the fulfillment.



Must-Have Requirements

4+ years of hands-on, agency-side or in-house media buying experience. (Managing monthly budgets of $50k+).



Mastery of Google Ads Manager (MCC), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and GA4.



Proven ability to build single-theme ad groups, implement strict negative keyword lists, and connect offline CRM conversion data.



Excellent, fluent English communication skills (written and spoken) to confidently lead strategy updates.



A proactive, "fix-it-before-it-breaks" mindset.



???? IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: Experience working in an outsourced BPO environment (e.g., Concentrix, Teleperformance, TaskUs, TeleTech) as a Google Ads Support Representative, Customer Care Agent, or Account Strategist does NOT qualify for this role. We strictly require a hands-on, independent media buyer.



How to Apply

To ensure we are a great mutual fit, please reply to this posting with the subject line: "Senior PPC: [Your Favorite Book or Movie]"



In your message, include a link to your updated resume and provide a brief (1-2 paragraph) answer to these three questions:



The "Google Rep" Scenario: Google Ads reps frequently call agencies pushing them to enable Auto-Apply Recommendations and Broad Match keywords. What is your philosophy on handling Google Rep recommendations, and why?



The Architecture Scenario: In your current or most recent role, did you primarily inherit existing ad accounts to troubleshoot, or did you build them from scratch? If you built them, walk us through your high-level process for structuring a new local service campaign.



The Bad Data Scenario: You notice a client’s Google Ads dashboard shows 15 conversions this week, but the client
s you angry, saying their CRM only shows 2 new leads. What is your immediate technical troubleshooting process?



Applications that use AI to generate answers or fail to follow the application instructions will be automatically discarded.

I'm Thuy Le — a UK-based content creator known as xthuyle, with 1.9M followers on Instagram, 1.2M on TikTok, and 470k on YouTube. I'm building a digital products and creator education brand called The Future Creator, and I need a creative lead who can take full ownership of our content strategy and production.



This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll be the person who thinks about what we should be making, scripts and briefs the videos, studies the analytics to understand why content performs, and then executes — editing, designing, repurposing, and keeping us ahead of trends. You'll work inside a small, tight remote team and report directly to me.



This is not a task-taker role. I need someone who brings ideas, spots opportunities before I do, and takes full ownership of the content operation from strategy through to publication.



What you'll own

Content strategy & scripting

Batch-produce 5–10 short-form clips from a single filming session

Find and match trending sounds to existing footage — proactively, without being asked

Maintain a 4–6 week content buffer so we're never scrambling

B-roll library & asset management



Organise and maintain the full b-roll library — categorised, labelled, easy to search

Flag when any b-roll category is running low ahead of filming days

Build content from existing b-roll without needing new footage wherever possible

Keep all footage, assets, and files organised so the whole team can find things instantly

AI-powered workflow



Use AI tools as a core part of your workflow — voice cloning, AI avatars, AI scriptwriting assistance

Work inside Claude Projects for briefs, hooks, and captions

Test new AI tools as they emerge and bring recommendations to the team

Document AI workflows so the whole team benefits from what you build

Turn testimonials and results into shareable branded visuals

Monitor community conversations and flag anything worth acting on

 & Instagram) — creating and managing paid campaigns

 newsletter experience — drafting, formatting, and scheduling

Converting landing page knowledge

A strong portfolio showing long-form video edits, short-form clips, AND graphic design work — all three are required

title: Masonry & Concrete Estimating Takeoff Specialist
description:
**Location:** Remote 



**Reports To:** Chief Estimator / Operations Manager



## Position Summary



**Masonry & Concrete Estimating Takeoff Specialist** responsible for reviewing construction drawings, blueprints, specifications, and project documents to accurately quantify materials and labor requirements for bidding purposes. This position focuses on performing quantity takeoffs for masonry, concrete, CMU block, brick veneer, rebar, grout, and related construction scopes.



The ideal candidate must be experienced in reading U.S. construction plans and capable of providing accurate material quantities that allow the estimating team to prepare competitive and profitable bids.



## Key Responsibilities



* Review architectural, structural, and civil drawings.

* Analyze project plans, specifications, and bid documents.

* Perform quantity takeoffs for:



  * CMU Block

  * Brick Veneer

  * Concrete Foundations

  * Concrete Walls

  * Slabs

  * Footings

  * Rebar Reinforcement

  * Grout and Block Fill

  * Lintels

  * Masonry Accessories

  * Waterproofing Materials

* Calculate square footage, linear footage, cubic yards, and material counts.

* Identify scope discrepancies, missing details, and plan conflicts.

* Prepare detailed takeoff reports for estimating and project management teams.

* Track plan revisions and update quantities accordingly.

* Assist estimators in developing project budgets and bid proposals.

* Communicate with project managers regarding quantity clarifications.

* Maintain organized digital records of takeoffs and project documentation.



## Required Qualifications



* Minimum 2 years of experience reading construction blueprints.

* Strong understanding of U.S. construction drawings and specifications.

* Experience with masonry, concrete, and structural plans.

* Proficient in construction mathematics and quantity calculations.

* Ability to identify elevations, sections, details, schedules, and structural notes.

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

* Proficient with Microsoft Excel.

* Ability to work independently and meet bid deadlines.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience in masonry estimating.

* Construction or engineering background.

* Experience working with commercial construction projects.



## Knowledge Required



The candidate should understand:



### Masonry



* CMU block sizes and types

* Reinforced masonry

* Bond beams

* Control joints

* Mortar types

* Grout requirements

* Masonry wall assemblies



### Brick



* Brick veneer systems

* Brick coursing

* Brick ledges

* Expansion joints

* Flashing systems

* Brick tie spacing



### Concrete



* Footings

* Slabs-on-grade

* Foundation walls

* Retaining walls

* Concrete volume calculations

* Reinforcing steel placement



### Structural Drawings



* Rebar schedules

* Structural sections

* Concrete details

* Elevations

* Construction notes

* General specifications



## Desired Qualities



* Highly organized

* Detail-oriented

* Reliable

* Self-motivated

* Strong analytical skills

* Excellent communication skills

* Ability to work under tight deadlines

* Problem solver

* Team player



## Performance Expectations



The successful candidate will provide:



* Accurate quantity takeoffs with minimal errors.

* Complete takeoff reports before bid deadlines.

* Identification of potential change order opportunities.

* Clear documentation supporting all material quantities.

* Consistent communication with estimating and project management teams.



**Compensation:** Based on experience.



This position plays a critical role in ensuring accurate project pricing and profitability by delivering precise material and labor quantities from construction drawings.

title: Invoice & Price Book Data Analyst (Petrosoft)

**Position Summary:**

The Invoice & Price Book Data Analyst is responsible for managing invoice entry, maintaining accurate product pricing, updating the Petrosoft Back Office system, and monitoring vendor cost changes. This position plays a critical role in ensuring product pricing accuracy, maximizing promotional opportunities, and protecting profit margins by identifying product cost increases and maintaining an up-to-date price book.



### Key Responsibilities

* Enter and process vendor invoices accurately into the Petrosoft Back Office system.

* Maintain and update the store price book, including product descriptions, costs, retail pricing, UPCs, and vendor information.

* Monitor vendor invoices for product cost increases and communicate significant changes to management.

* Review product margins and recommend retail price adjustments when costs change.

* Create, update, and activate promotional pricing, discounts, and vendor-sponsored deals within Petrosoft.

* Verify that promotional pricing is implemented correctly and removed when promotions expire.

* Ensure pricing consistency between invoices, shelf tags, POS systems, and the Petrosoft database.

* Analyze purchasing trends and identify opportunities to improve profitability.

* Research and resolve invoice discrepancies, pricing errors, and vendor billing issues.

* Generate reports on product costs, margins, promotions, and inventory pricing.

* Work closely with store management, vendors, and accounting personnel to maintain accurate records.

* Maintain organized digital records of invoices and pricing updates.



### Qualifications

* Previous experience with Petrosoft Back Office, convenience store operations, accounts payable, inventory management, or price book maintenance preferred.

* Strong data entry and analytical skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools.

* Ability to identify pricing trends and cost fluctuations.

* Strong organizational and communication skills.



### Preferred Experience

* Petrosoft Back Office System

* Convenience Store or Gas Station Operations

* Price Book Management

* Invoice Processing

* Vendor Relations

* Inventory Control

* Retail Pricing Strategies

* Promotional Program Management



### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Invoice entry accuracy rate.

* Timeliness of invoice processing.

* Price book accuracy and completeness.

* Successful implementation of promotional pricing.

* Identification and reporting of product cost increases.

* Gross profit margin protection through pricing updates.

* Reduction in pricing discrepancies and billing errors.



**Position Goal:**

To ensure all invoices, product costs, retail prices, and promotional programs are accurately maintained within Petrosoft, allowing the company to maximize profitability, maintain pricing integrity, and respond quickly to market and vendor cost changes.

description:
The Compliance Services Organization didn’t exist. We built it.



MP1 Solutions pioneered the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined compliance programs for decades. Built on the foundation of MedPro Disposal, the nation’s largest privately-held medical waste company serving 35,000+ providers across 48 states over the past 15 years, MP1 Solutions extends that operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we’re actively building — and leading.



What we do:

We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice’s behalf.



Why it matters:

Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We’re changing that — and we’re looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology:

We’re actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you’re in the right place.

title: Long-Term YouTube Video Editor — Reality / Docu-Comedy Series (Cars & Travel)
description:
ABOUT US



MOTORIOT is a US-based vintage 4x4 restoration company launching a 

weekly YouTube series in May 2026. The show is in the style of reality 

docu-comedy — think Top Gear meets The Office, with elements of 

Anthony Bourdain's Parts Unknown. We restore rare Land Rover Defenders, 

Toyota Land Cruisers, Ford Broncos, and similar vintage trucks for 

high-net-worth clients worldwide.



The show follows two founders running this business — one based at our 

Connecticut shop, one running operations from NYC and LA — with builders 

in Spain, Lithuania, Ecuador, and Colombia. Every episode mixes shop 

scenes, FaceTime calls with overseas builders, customer drama, and a 

healthy dose of comedy.



We are hiring a long-term editor to be the primary cutter for the 

channel after the first two episodes (which are being cut by a 

US-based editor whose work will serve as your "north star" reference).



THE WORK



You will be cutting:

- One 8 to 12 minute episode per week

- Three to five Shorts per week (under 60 seconds, vertical, pulled 

  from existing footage)

- Occasional longer tentpole episodes (18 to 25 minutes) released 

  every 6 to 8 weeks



Each episode follows a structured brief we send you. We don't expect 

you to invent the story — we provide:

- A detailed written brief with scene-by-scene breakdown and timecodes

- A clear A-story spine and the B-story threads to weave in

- Reference cuts and tone notes

- Music library access (we license through Musicbed or Artlist)

- All footage organized in a clearly labeled shared drive



You will be cutting from multi-camera footage that includes:

- Shop scenes (broadcast camera + B camera + phone capture)

- FaceTime calls and screen recordings

- Talking-head confessional interviews

- Voiceover audio from the founders

- Builder-captured footage from Spain, Lithuania, and Ecuador



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years editing YouTube content. Reel required.

- Strong English comprehension — must understand US idioms, sarcasm, 

  and comedic timing.

- Premiere Pro proficiency. Comfortable with 
 for review and 

  feedback.

- Experience cutting reality, documentary, or docu-comedy content. 

  This is NOT a tutorial channel, NOT a vlog. Please do not apply 

  if your reel is mostly explainer videos.

- Music supervision instincts — picking the right cue for the 
nt.

- Comfortable layering voiceover over silent B-roll (Bourdain style).

- Available for daily Slack communication during US evening hours 

  (which is your morning). About 30 minutes of overlap most days, 

  plus a weekly 30-minute video call.

- Reliable internet capable of downloading and uploading large files.



COMPENSATION



$10 to $12 USD per hour depending on experience. Weekly pay via 

Wise or PayPal.



We estimate 25 to 30 hours per week including episodes and Shorts. 

This is a real long-term role — we are building a multi-year channel 

and want to grow with one editor, not rotate through freelancers.



TURNAROUND



- v1 cut of each episode within 3 working days of brief delivery

- v2 cut within 1 working day of receiving notes

- Locked cut delivered by Day 9 of the production-to-publish cycle



HOW TO APPLY



Please include in your application:



1. A link to your reel showing 3 to 5 previous YouTube edits. Reality 

   or docu-style edits get priority.



2. One short paragraph answering: "What makes a great reality-show 

   cut?" We want to hear your editing philosophy.



3. Mention your favorite YouTube channel in the auto, travel, or 

   reality space, and tell us in one sentence what their editor does 

   well.



4. Use the word "GEARBOX" somewhere in your application so we know you 

   read the full post.



After we shortlist applicants, we will send a paid 60-second short 

edit as a trial, using supplied footage. Trial editors are paid 

regardless of whether we hire them.



Thank you for reading this far. We are looking forward to working 

with the right person long-term.
